taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue amplifier core (TEST_FCT).
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Closed-loop switched-capacitor charge-transfer amplifier:
*  - The fixture flying capacitors dump their charge into the virtual
*    grounds cinp/cinn during transfer; feedback capacitors CF set the
*    gain (about Cs/CF) of a fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA.
*  - During sam the virtual grounds are reset to vcm (the flying-capacitor
*    output-plate potential) and shorted together, clearing the feedback
*    capacitor charge before each transfer.
*  - A switched-capacitor CMFB drives the tail current source so that the
*    output common mode settles at vcm.
*  - The OTA is biased from the 50 uA ib reference by current mirrors.
*  - Drain/source junction geometry (ad/as/pd/ps) is included explicitly.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- clock buffer: samb = not sam ----
XCK_P samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3 ad=2.32 as=2.32 pd=17.16 ps=17.16
XCK_N samb sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 ad=1.74 as=1.74 pd=12.58 ps=12.58

* ---- bias network (ib sinks the 50 uA reference) ----
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 ad=0.58 as=0.58 pd=4.58 ps=4.58
* PMOS current-source bias: vbp diode fed from the ib mirror
XMBPN vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 ad=0.58 as=0.58 pd=4.58 ps=4.58
XMBPP vbp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=2 ad=1.16 as=2.32 pd=8.58 ps=17.16
* NMOS cascode bias: regular-Vt diode sets the input-pair drain level,
* an LVT replica of the cascode device adds its gate-source voltage
XMCBS vcasn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1 ad=1.16 as=1.16 pd=8.58 ps=8.58
XMCBA vcasn vcasn ncb1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=1.6 nf=1 ad=0.464 as=0.464 pd=3.78 ps=3.78
XMCBB ncb1 ncb1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2 ad=2.9 as=5.8 pd=20.58 ps=41.16
* PMOS cascode bias: strongly inverted PMOS diode (wide-swing style)
XMPBS vcasp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XMPBA vcasp vcasp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58

* ---- telescopic OTA ----
XMT tail vctrl vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=96 nf=24 ad=13.92 as=15.08 pd=102.96 ps=111.54
XM1 x1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=24 ad=17.4 as=18.85 pd=126.96 ps=137.54
XM2 x2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=24 ad=17.4 as=18.85 pd=126.96 ps=137.54
XM3 coutp vcasn x1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=60 nf=12 ad=8.7 as=10.15 pd=63.48 ps=74.06
XM4 coutn vcasn x2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=60 nf=12 ad=8.7 as=10.15 pd=63.48 ps=74.06
XM5 coutp vcasp x3 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=12 ad=6.96 as=8.12 pd=51.48 ps=60.06
XM6 coutn vcasp x4 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=12 ad=6.96 as=8.12 pd=51.48 ps=60.06
XM7 x3 vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=211.2 nf=48 ad=30.624 as=31.9 pd=225.12 ps=234.5
XM8 x4 vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=211.2 nf=48 ad=30.624 as=31.9 pd=225.12 ps=234.5
* cascode-node differential reset: clears charge stored on CX1/CX2 by
* the virtual-ground kick of the fixture output precharge
XXS x1 sam x2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 ad=1.16 as=1.16 pd=8.58 ps=8.58
* cascode-node capacitors: set the non-dominant pole so the closed loop
* is close to critically damped, which settles faster than the nearly
* single-pole response of the bare telescopic OTA
CX1 x1 vssana 600f
CX2 x2 vssana 600f

* ---- feedback capacitors ----
CFP cinp coutp 61.5f
CFN cinn coutn 61.5f

* ---- virtual-ground reset during sam: to vcm and differential short ----
XRP_N cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 ad=2.32 as=2.32 pd=16.58 ps=16.58
XRP_P cinp samb vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1 ad=2.32 as=2.32 pd=16.58 ps=16.58
XRN_N cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1 ad=2.32 as=2.32 pd=16.58 ps=16.58
XRN_P cinn samb vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1 ad=2.32 as=2.32 pd=16.58 ps=16.58
XRD_N cinp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=1 ad=5.8 as=5.8 pd=40.58 ps=40.58
XRD_P cinp samb cinn vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=1 ad=5.8 as=5.8 pd=40.58 ps=40.58

* ---- switched-capacitor CMFB ----
* C1 senses the output common mode continuously and drives the tail gate.
* C2 is charged to (vcm - ib) during sam and is placed in parallel with C1
* while the amplifier is active, which sets the output common-mode target
* to vcm. The output-side C2 switches toggle only at the sam edges and the
* control-side switches follow a delayed copy of transfer, so no CMFB
* switch changes state near the output sampling instant.
C1P coutp vctrl 4f
C1N coutn vctrl 4f
C2P a2p b2p 4f
C2N a2n b2n 4f
XS2AP a2p sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2AN a2n sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2BP b2p sam ib vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2BN b2n sam ib vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2CP a2p samb coutp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2CN a2n samb coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
* transfer delayed by four inverters: C2 control-side switch turns off
* only after the output has been sampled at the end of transfer
XDLY0_P trd1 transfer vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 ad=0.2436 as=0.2436 pd=2.26 ps=2.26
XDLY0_N trd1 transfer vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 ad=0.1218 as=0.1218 pd=1.42 ps=1.42
XDLY1_P trd2 trd1 vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 ad=0.2436 as=0.2436 pd=2.26 ps=2.26
XDLY1_N trd2 trd1 vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 ad=0.1218 as=0.1218 pd=1.42 ps=1.42
XDLY2_P trd3 trd2 vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 ad=0.2436 as=0.2436 pd=2.26 ps=2.26
XDLY2_N trd3 trd2 vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 ad=0.1218 as=0.1218 pd=1.42 ps=1.42
XDLY3_P trd trd3 vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 ad=0.2436 as=0.2436 pd=2.26 ps=2.26
XDLY3_N trd trd3 vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 ad=0.1218 as=0.1218 pd=1.42 ps=1.42
XS2DP b2p trd vctrl vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
XS2DN b2n trd vctrl vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58
* very weak always-on device defining the DC level of the CMFB node
* at power-up (start-up aid; negligible against the SC CMFB)
XLEAK vctrl vddana ib vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=0.42 nf=1 ad=0.1218 as=0.1218 pd=1.42 ps=1.42

.ends test_fct

gates.measurement: 10/10 unique finite transients: tt/ss/ff/fs/sf at 10mV and 20mV

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential FCT residue amplifier core (Sky130).
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Charge amplifier: an LVT-NMOS-input telescopic-cascode OTA with ideal
* feedback capacitors CF from each output back to its summing node. During
* TRANSFER the fixture's 400 fF flying capacitors dump their sampled charge
* into the virtual grounds, so Vout,diff = (C_fly/CF)*Vin,diff (finite-gain
* corrected). During SAM the core is reset: summing nodes shorted together
* and to VCM, outputs shorted together (the fixture also precharges them to
* VOCM), the OTA cascode sources shorted so the OTA has no differential gain
* while being reset, and the switched-capacitor CMFB node is reset to its
* bias. SAMB-driven capacitors cancel the reset-switch clock feedthrough.
* TRANSFER needs no core-side switching (the fixture reconnects the flying
* capacitors); the core is simply released from reset when SAM falls.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- complementary reset clock (digital supply)
XINV_SAM_N samb sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 ad=0.58 as=0.58 pd=4.58 ps=4.58
XINV_SAM_P samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 ad=1.16 as=1.16 pd=8.58 ps=8.58

* ---- bias network from the 50 uA reference sunk at IB
XMB_REF ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.402 nf=2 ad=0.9283 as=1.8566 pd=6.982 ps=13.964
XMB_NP vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.402 nf=2 ad=0.9283 as=1.8566 pd=6.982 ps=13.964
XMB_PD vbp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.645 nf=4 ad=1.2535 as=1.8803 pd=9.805 ps=14.7075
* PMOS cascode gate: NMOS-mirror current into a low-W/L PMOS diode
XMB_NC vbcp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.402 nf=2 ad=0.9283 as=1.8566 pd=6.982 ps=13.964
XMB_CP vbcp vbcp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.958 nf=1 ad=0.5678 as=0.5678 pd=4.496 ps=4.496
* NMOS cascode gate referenced to the OTA tail node: vbcn = V(tail) +
* I*R(poly) + Vgs(M2 replica), so the input-pair Vds tracks the input
* common mode and NMOS threshold instead of fighting it
XMB_PC vbcn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2 ad=0.58 as=1.16 pd=4.58 ps=9.16
XMB_CN1 vbcn vbcn xr vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=1.25 nf=1 ad=0.3625 as=0.3625 pd=3.08 ps=3.08
XR_LEV xr tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=0.5 l=16

* ---- telescopic cascode OTA (coutp is the output inverting w.r.t. cinp)
XMTAIL tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=238 nf=119 ad=34.8 as=34.8 pd=274.8 ps=274.8
XMTAIL_CM tail cmfb vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10 ad=2.9 as=3.48 pd=22.9 ps=27.48
XM1P xp cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.18 w=100 nf=50 ad=14.5 as=15.08 pd=114.5 ps=119.08
XM1N xn cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.18 w=100 nf=50 ad=14.5 as=15.08 pd=114.5 ps=119.08
XM2P coutp vbcn xp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=50 nf=25 ad=7.54 as=7.54 pd=59.54 ps=59.54
XM2N coutn vbcn xn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=50 nf=25 ad=7.54 as=7.54 pd=59.54 ps=59.54
XM3P coutp vbcp yp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=60 nf=30 ad=8.7 as=9.28 pd=68.7 ps=73.28
XM3N coutn vbcp yn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=60 nf=30 ad=8.7 as=9.28 pd=68.7 ps=73.28
XM4P yp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=96 ad=27.84 as=28.42 pd=219.84 ps=224.42
XM4N yn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=192 nf=96 ad=27.84 as=28.42 pd=219.84 ps=224.42
* cascode-node capacitors: place the non-dominant pole for near-critically
* damped closed-loop settling
CXP xp vssana 400f
CXN xn vssana 400f

* ---- switched-capacitor CMFB acting on the OTA tail current
CCMP coutp cmfb 4f
CCMN coutn cmfb 4f
* CMFB reset level from a short-L replica diode of MTAIL_CM so the CMFB tail
* current at reset tracks the process corner (keeps N/P currents balanced)
XMB_TCP vtcm vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.893 nf=2 ad=0.5645 as=1.129 pd=4.473 ps=8.946
XMB_TCR vtcm vtcm vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 ad=0.58 as=0.58 pd=4.58 ps=4.58
CTCM vtcm vssana 200f
XSW_CM cmfb sam vtcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 ad=0.29 as=0.29 pd=2.58 ps=2.58

* ---- charge-transfer feedback capacitors
CFP coutp cinp 63.4f
CFN coutn cinn 63.4f

* ---- reset switches (active while SAM is high)
XSW_SUM cinp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=9 ad=6.4444 as=6.4444 pd=47.3444 ps=47.3444
XSW_INP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2 ad=1.16 as=2.32 pd=8.58 ps=17.16
XSW_INN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2 ad=1.16 as=2.32 pd=8.58 ps=17.16
XSW_OUT coutp sam coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=15 nf=5 ad=2.61 as=2.61 pd=19.74 ps=19.74
XSW_X xp sam xn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=5 ad=2.61 as=2.61 pd=19.74 ps=19.74

* ---- clock-feedthrough compensation driven by SAMB
CKP cinp samb 12f
CKN cinn samb 12f
CKOP coutp samb 2f
CKON coutn samb 2f
CKCM cmfb samb 0.3f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Closed-loop charge-transfer amplifier.  The fixture's flying capacitors
* dump their charge into the virtual-ground nodes cinp/cinn of a fully
* differential LVT-NMOS-input telescopic OTA with capacitive feedback Cf, so
* the gain is set by the capacitor ratio C_fly/Cf.  During sam the OTA inputs
* are reset to vcm and the outputs are equalized; the fixture's 0.9 V output
* precharge then sets the output common mode for the following transfer.
* Bias devices are finger-matched replicas of the core devices: the PMOS
* loads mirror the 50 uA reference through a cascode replica, and the tail
* is set by a replica of the input device (gate at vcm) stacked on a tail
* replica, so it sinks exactly twice the load current.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- clock drivers ----------------
* NMOS switch gates are driven directly by sam; samb drives the PMOS halves.
XISN samb sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XISP samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
* transfer only loads a minimum inverter: the amplifier core is static
XITN transb transfer vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XITP transb transfer vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ---------------- bias network ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
CBN ib vssana 2e-12
* PMOS load bias: one-finger cascode replica of load + cascode (50 uA)
XMB1 vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
XMPB ypr vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=8 nf=1
XMPBC vbp vbpc ypr vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=2.5 nf=1
CBP vbp vddana 2e-12
* PMOS cascode gate bias (high current density diode, 50 uA)
XMB2 vbpc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
XMPC vbpc vbpc vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=0.42 nf=1
CBPC vbpc vssana 2e-12
* tail bias: two load fingers (100 uA) into one input-device finger (gate
* at vcm) on two tail fingers whose gate is the input replica's drain
XMRP yrr vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16 nf=2
XMRPC vtg vbpc yrr vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=5 nf=2
XMRI vtg vcm vtr vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.18 w=10.67 nf=1
XMRT vtr vtg vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12 nf=2
CBTG vtg vssana 2e-12
* NMOS cascode gate bias: identical PMOS diodes split vdd-vcm equally
XDV0 vdv1 vdv1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XDV1 vdv2 vdv2 vdv1 vdv1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XDV2 vdv3 vdv3 vdv2 vdv2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XDV3 vdv4 vdv4 vdv3 vdv3 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XDV4 vcm vcm vdv4 vdv4 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
CBNC vdv3 vssana 2e-12

* ---------------- telescopic OTA ----------------
* input pair (cinp drives the coutn side)
XM1A xa cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.18 w=96.03 nf=9
XM1B xb cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.18 w=96.03 nf=9
* NMOS cascodes
XM2A coutn vdv3 xa vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.2 w=36 nf=9
XM2B coutp vdv3 xb vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.2 w=36 nf=9
* PMOS cascodes
XM3A coutn vbpc ya vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=45 nf=18
XM3B coutp vbpc yb vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=45 nf=18
* PMOS loads
XM4A ya vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=144 nf=18
XM4B yb vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=144 nf=18
* tail
XMT tail vtg vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=216 nf=36

* ---------------- feedback capacitors ----------------
CFA coutn cinp 6.2e-14
CFB coutp cinn 6.2e-14

* ---------------- reset switches (on during sam) ----------------
* OTA inputs to vcm
XSIA cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=3
XSIB cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=3
XSIAP cinp samb vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
XSIBP cinn samb vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
* input equalization: zeroes the differential input charge directly
XSEI cinp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XSEIP cinp samb cinn vcm sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
* output equalization (clears the held differential before the precharge)

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body).
* Single-stage telescopic cascode OTA with capacitive charge-transfer feedback.
* The fixture owns the flying capacitors, sampler, output precharge and T/H.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference / bias network.  The 50 uA ib source is terminated in a diode
* connected NMOS; all bias currents are geometric multiples of that current.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference diode (sets the tail and sink gate bias).
XMNB ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.9 nf=1

* Differential pair tail current source.
XMTAIL tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=500 nf=7

* PMOS reference: 50 uA NMOS sink into a diode connected PMOS.
XMNPREF pbref ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.9 nf=1
XMPREF pbref pbref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.7 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate bias: two diode connected NMOS in series, fed by a
* 50 uA PMOS source (current density rails with the main cascodes).
XMPCA vbnc_top pbref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMNCA vbnc_top vbnc_top vbnc_mid vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
XMNCB vbnc_mid vbnc_mid vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1

* PMOS cascode gate bias: high current density PMOS diode, 50 uA sink.
XMNPB vbpc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.9 nf=1
XMPCB vbpc vbpc vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main telescopic cascode differential amplifier.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS input differential pair (gates at the transferred virtual grounds).
XM1 d1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=6
XM2 d2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=6

* NMOS cascode devices.
XM3 coutp vbnc_top d1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=135 nf=4
XM4 coutn vbnc_top d2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=135 nf=4

* PMOS current-source loads.  Sized to carry the input pair current in
* saturation at the mirror gate voltage; the previous 1000 um devices sat in
* triode, loading the internal source node with a large slow capacitance.
XMP3 coutp vbpc p1p vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XMP1 p1p pbref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1000 nf=1
XMP4 coutn vbpc p1n vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1
XMP2 p1n pbref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1000 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Charge-transfer feedback capacitors (Cfly/Cfb = 400f/67f ~ 5.97 V/V).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CFBP coutp cinp 57f
CFBN coutn cinn 57f

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reset: during sam the feedback capacitors are shorted and both virtual
* ground inputs are tied to vcm.  The switches operate around the 1.0 V input
* common mode, so they are PMOS pass switches whose bodies sit at vddana:
* this keeps the source/drain junctions reverse biased and avoids the large
* clock feedthrough a minimum-channel NMOS shows on a floating input node.
* sam_b is the local complement of sam (CMOS inverter).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

XMIP sam_b sam vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMRP cinp sam_b coutp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XMRN cinn sam_b coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
* The input virtual grounds are held at vcm whenever the transfer clock is
* low: during sam and also through the sam-to-transfer gap, so the fixture
* flying capacitors always connect to a known vcm input node.
XMINP cinp transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XMINN cinn transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
* Kill the differential state directly during sam without touching the
* output common mode (which is free to sit at its natural operating point).
* Clamping the input side to vcm alone leaves the differential nodes
* discharging only through the reset switch resistances, which is slow enough
* to leave a carry from cycle to cycle and a slow low-bin transient.
XMDS coutp sam coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=4
XMINDS cinp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=2

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Core: telescopic-cascode differential OTA used as a charge amplifier.
*   - fixture flying caps (400 fF) dump charge into cinp/cinn
*   - internal feedback caps Cfb set the residue gain ~ Cfly/Cfb
*   - cinp/cinn are reset to vcm while sam is high; the fixture precharges
*     the outputs to vocm over the same window, resetting the feedback caps
*   - input pair is cascoded so its Cgd is not Miller-multiplied
*   - ib (50 uA) is the master bias reference
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode (NMOS)
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* PMOS bias branch: 20x NMOS sink makes the PMOS diode carry ~1 mA
XMBP bp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
XMP0 bp bp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=110 nf=2

* cascode bias: 1/5 PMOS mirror feeds two diode NMOS in series
XMP3 vcasc bp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=1
XMC1 vcasc vcasc vcn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=19 nf=2
XMC2 vcn vcn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=19 nf=2

* ---------------- differential OTA ----------------
* tail current source: 40x reference -> ~2 mA
XMTL tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=8

* input pair (LVT NMOS)
XMN1 d1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=12
XMN2 d2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=12

* cascode devices (isolate input Cgd from the output)
XMC3 coutn vcasc d1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XMC4 coutp vcasc d2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=2

* PMOS current-source loads (~1 mA each)
XMP1 coutn bp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=110 nf=2
XMP2 coutp bp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=110 nf=2

* ---------------- charge-transfer feedback ----------------
CFBP cinp coutn 55f
CFBN cinn coutp 55f

* ---------------- input reset switches ----------------
* LVT NMOS pass switches to vcm, on while sam is high.
* D G S B: gate = sam, source/bulk = vcm (no body effect).
XRSN cinn sam vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XRSP cinp sam vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer (FCT) residue amplifier
* MOS terminal order: D G S B
* Core: single-stage NMOS-input cascode OTA with capacitively fed-back
* residue gain.  The fixture flying capacitors deliver a differential charge
* packet into cinn/cinp; Cfb sets the residue gain Cfly/Cfb.
* Reset (unity feedback + input common-mode precharge) is performed while
* sam is high, so the core is ready before transfer rises.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation from the 50 uA ib reference
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 50 uA diode reference -> NMOS gate bias
XMN_IB      ib   ib   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* tail current mirror (45x -> ~2.1 mA), low Vdsat
XMN_TAIL    tailn ib  vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=180 nf=18
* 50 uA NMOS sink used by the PMOS bias diode
XMN_PBSINK  pb   ib   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS diode (50 uA) -> PMOS gate bias
XMP_BIAS    pb   pb   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* PMOS branch current sources (~1.1 mA each)
XMP_TOP1    coutn pb   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=225 nf=20
XMP_TOP2    coutp pb   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=225 nf=20

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS cascode gate bias (~1.2 V) : PMOS current source + two NMOS diodes
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP_CASBS   vcasn pb   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMN_CASB1   vcasn vcasn mid    mid  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
XMN_CASB2   mid   mid   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
* bias decoupling
CBN         ib   vssana 1p
CBP         pb   vddana 1p
CCASN       vcasn vssana 1p

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Telescopic-style OTA: NMOS input pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS current load
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* input pair (~1.05 mA each), bulk tied to source (common source node)
XMN_IN1     n1   cinp tailn tailn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=96 nf=16
XMN_IN2     n2   cinn tailn tailn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=96 nf=16
* NMOS cascodes, bulk tied to source
XMN_CAS1    coutn vcasn n1   n1   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XMN_CAS2    coutp vcasn n2   n2   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=20

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Switched-capacitor feedback / reset
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 400 fF flying cap (fixture) / 60 fF feedback -> differential gain ~6
CFB_P       cinp coutn 60f
CFB_N       cinn coutp 60f
* input common-mode precharge and feedback reset switches (sam high)
XSW_CM_P    cinp sam vcm   vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XSW_CM_N    cinn sam vcm   vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XSW_RST_P   cinp sam coutn vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12
XSW_RST_N   cinn sam coutp vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=12

.ends test_fct

* testbenches own the sampler, flying capacitors, output precharge, and output
* track-and-hold fixture. Ideal switches, relays, independent/controlled
* sources, and behavioural active elements are not legal in this deliverable.

* network here. Ideal capacitors are allowed for the original internal
* functional capacitors.

* establishes a zero-charge initial condition; the transconductor then holds
* CINP/CINN near VCM while the fixture transfers its stored charge.

CFBN cinn coutn 48f

XPSAMB samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=20

XRSINN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XRSIPP cinp samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=4
XRSINP cinn samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Switched-capacitor charge amplifier.
*   sam      : cinp/cinn are reset to vcm and the two outputs are shorted, so
*              the feedback capacitors restart each cycle in the same state and
*              the bench output precharge injects no differential step.
*   transfer : the bench dumps the flying-capacitor charge onto cinp/cinn; the
*              telescopic cascode OTA holds the virtual ground and drives that
*              charge into the feedback caps, so Vout = (Cfly/Cfb)*Vin.
*   a switched-capacitor common-mode loop steers part of the tail current so
*   the output common mode tracks the bench precharge level.
* Every ~1 V switch is a transmission gate: the low-Vt nmos gives a low on
* resistance at the 1 V common mode and the pmos cancels its clock feedthrough.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ------------------------------------------------------------- clocking ---
XINVN samb sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINVP samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* the transfer port only has to stay loaded; the core needs no transfer gating
XTDUMN vssdig transfer vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTDUMP vdddig transfer vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------- virtual ground reset -
XRSTPN cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=3
XRSTPP cinp samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=3
XRSTNN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=3
XRSTNP cinn samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=3

* -------------------------------------------------------- output equalize --
XEQN coutp sam coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XEQP coutp samb coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------- feedback capacitors ----
CFBP cinp coutp 64f
CFBN cinn coutn 64f

* ----------------------------------------------------------- input pair ---
XMINP nda cinp ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=110 nf=17
XMINN ndb cinn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=110 nf=17

* ------------------------------------------------------- nmos cascodes ----
XMCNP coutp vbcn nda vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=40 nf=7
XMCNN coutn vbcn ndb vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=40 nf=7

* ------------------------------------------------------- pmos cascodes ----
XMCPP coutp vbcp npa vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=55 nf=9
XMCPN coutn vbcp npb vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=55 nf=9

* ---------------------------------------------------------- pmos loads ----
XMLDP npa vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=330 nf=51
XMLDN npb vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=330 nf=51

* ----------------------------------------------------------------- tail ---
XMTF ntail vbn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=90 nf=14
XMTC ntail ncmfb vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4

* ----------------------------------------- switched capacitor common mode -
CCMP coutp ncmfb 12f
CCMN coutn ncmfb 12f
XSWCMN ncmfb sam vbnh vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSWCMP ncmfb samb vbnh vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ----------------------------------------------------------------- bias ---
* 50 uA reference sunk from the ib port
XBREF ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
* cascoded pmos reference branch: vbp settles for the mirrored load current
XBSNK vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
XBPC vbp vbcp nrp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2.75 nf=1
XBPL nrp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16.5 nf=3
* pmos cascode gate bias (wide swing level)
XBCPD vbcp vbcp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=5 nf=1
XBCPS vbcp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1
* nmos cascode gate bias, referenced to the amplifier tail node so the input
* pair keeps its saturation margin over every process corner
XBCNS vbcn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XBCND vbcn vbcn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.42 nf=1
* tail gate bias and common mode reset level
XBNS vbnh vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XBNHD vbnh vbnh vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XBNS2 vbn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XBND vbn vbn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=6 nf=1

CDVBCP vbcp vddana 500f

CDVBN  vbn  vssana 300f

circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier core (transistor-level TEST_FCT).
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture: fully differential telescopic-cascode charge-transfer amplifier.
* The bench-owned 400 fF flying caps deliver signal charge into cinp/cinn,
* which are the amplifier summing nodes.  Ideal internal feedback caps CF set
* the closed-loop charge gain ~ 400f/CF (~6 V/V after loop/settling losses).
* During sam the summing nodes are reset to vcm through transmission gates and
* the bench precharges the outputs to 0.9 V, so every cycle starts from the
* same state (no inter-symbol memory).  Output common mode is defined by the
* bench precharge each cycle; matched mirror currents bound its drift, so no
* explicit CMFB loop is required.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network (50 uA into ib) ----------------
* NMOS reference diode and tail mirror (42x -> 2.1 mA).
XDN1 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XMT  tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=504 nf=126

* NMOS mirrors feeding the PMOS bias diodes (50 uA each).
XDN2 pdio ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XDN3 pcas ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3

* PMOS load-mirror diode (25 uA per 4 um finger) and cascode-gate diode
* (high density so pcas sits low and the loads keep Vsd headroom).
XDP1 pdio pdio vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XDP2 pcas pcas vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate: 25 uA PMOS mirror into a stacked NMOS diode string.
XDP3 nbc pdio vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XDN4 nbc nbc nbc2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDN5 nbc2 nbc2 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- telescopic cascode core ----------------
XM1 x1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=80 nf=20
XM2 x2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=80 nf=20
XM3 coutp nbc x1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=64 nf=16
XM4 coutn nbc x2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=64 nf=16
XM5 coutp pcas y1 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=128 nf=32
XM6 coutn pcas y2 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=128 nf=32
XM7 y1 pdio vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=176 nf=44
XM8 y2 pdio vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=176 nf=44

* Ideal internal feedback capacitors (closed-loop gain = 400f/CF).
CFA cinp coutp 68f
CFB cinn coutn 68f

* ---------------- input reset switches (sam phase) ----------------
XSWN1 cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSWP1 cinp samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XSWN2 cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSWP2 cinn samb vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4

* sam complement for the PMOS half of the transmission gates.
XINVP samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Operation
* ---------
* During 'transfer' the bench flying capacitors (400 fF) dump their sampled
* differential charge onto cinp/cinn.  Each cinX node is the source of a
* common-gate charge-transfer device, so it behaves as a virtual ground
* pinned to vcm and the complete transferred charge is passed on to coutX.
* The total capacitance on coutX (50 fF bench load + local parasitics + trim
* capacitor) therefore fixes a purely capacitive voltage gain
*     Av = Cfly / Cout ~ 6 V/V,
* which is set by a capacitance ratio and is hence corner insensitive.
*
* The charge path is folded: an LVT NMOS common-gate device (M1) carries the
* charge up to n1X (~1.3 V) and a PMOS cascode (M2) folds it back down into
* coutX (~0.9 V).  Folding is what allows a 1.0 V virtual ground to coexist
* with a mid supply output while every device stays saturated, and it keeps
* the devices that load coutX narrow, which is what makes the ~6 V/V
* capacitance ratio reachable at all.
*
* Bias: a quarter scale replica of one half branch self-biases the output
* sink (vbno) so the output branch is current balanced, and a servo forces
* the replica virtual ground onto vcm, which pins cinX to vcm and therefore
* cancels the common-mode charge of the flying capacitors.  Long channel
* bottom devices with short narrow cascodes give a high output resistance
* (low droop) with very little capacitance on coutX.
*
* The core is fully static: coutX is re-initialised to vocm by the bench
* precharge every cycle, so no internal clocking and no clock power.
*
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*---------------- current reference -----------------------------------
XMIBC    ib     vbnc   nibc   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=10
XMIBD    nibc   ib     vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=10
CBVBN  ib   vssana 2p

* PMOS mirror reference (cascode connected diode)
XMPRB    nprc   vbp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=25 nf=12

XMFP_P   npf_P  vbp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=216 nf=108
XMFC_P   n1_P   vbpc   npf_P  vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=30
XM1_P    n1_P   vb1    cinp   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=55 nf=28
XMS1C_P  cinp   vbnc2  ns1_P  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=30

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s FCT residue amplifier core
* Fully differential telescopic OTA used as a switched-capacitor
* charge-transfer stage. The bench flying caps (400f) dump charge into
* cinp/cinn virtual grounds; internal ideal feedback caps set the gain
* ~ 400f/CFB. During sam the summing nodes are reset to vcm and the
* outputs are shorted to the summing nodes (unity reset). Split PMOS
* load with SC common-mode feedback regulates the output CM.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network ----------------
* master diode at ib (50 uA in), also tail mirror gate
XMB1 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
* tail current source, 46x -> 2.3 mA
XMT tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=322 nf=46
* 100 uA sink for cascoded PMOS mirror reference leg
XMB2 vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=14 nf=2
* PMOS mirror reference: diode closed through matched cascode
XMB3 pr vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMB4 vbp vbpc pr vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=14 nf=2
* PMOS cascode gate bias: 30 uA through narrow PMOS diode
XMB5 vbpc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1
XMB6 vbpc vbpc vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
* NMOS cascode gate bias: 30 uA through stacked NMOS diodes
XMB7 vbnc vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XMB8 vbnc vbnc nx vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=1
XMB9 nx nx vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=1
* CMFB trim replica bias: 30 uA through scaled copy of trim PMOS
XMB10 vbpt ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1
XMB11 vbpt vbpt vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=9 nf=1

* ---------------- telescopic core ----------------
XM1 n1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=110 nf=22
XM2 n2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=110 nf=22
XM3 coutn vbnc n1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=72 nf=12
XM4 coutp vbnc n2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=72 nf=12

XM6 coutp vbpc p2 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=140 nf=28

XM8 p2 vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=456 nf=76

XM7T p1 vcmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=60 nf=12
XM8T p2 vcmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=60 nf=12

* outputs couple into vcmfb; refreshed to replica bias during sam so the

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating-charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture: switched-capacitor charge amplifier.
*   - During "sam" the summing nodes cinn/cinp are reset to vcm through low-Vt
*     NMOS switches while the bench precharges coutn/coutp to vocm; this zeroes
*     the internal feedback capacitors CFP/CFN.
*   - During "transfer" the bench dumps the sampled differential charge onto
*     cinn/cinp.  A fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA holds those nodes
*     at vcm and forces the charge onto CFP/CFN, so that
*         vout_diff = (C_fly / CF) * vin_diff.
*   - A slow common-mode loop referenced to vcm nulls the systematic load/tail
*     current difference so the output common mode does not walk.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network.  The bench pushes 50 uA into ib; XMREF sinks it.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMREF   ib    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=4 nf=1
XMNPREF pref  ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=4 nf=1
XMPREF  pref  pref  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=2

* NMOS cascode gate bias: diode referenced to the OTA tail node so that the
* input-pair drain voltage tracks the tail voltage over process corners.
XMPNBC  nbc   pref  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.5 nf=2
XMBC    nbc   nbc   tail   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1

* PMOS cascode gate bias (high current density diode -> wide-swing style).
XMNPBC  pbc   ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=4 nf=1
XMPBC   pbc   pbc   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.55 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fully differential telescopic cascode OTA.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMTAIL  tail  ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=206 nf=42
XM1     nxp   cinp  tail   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=66 nf=22
XM2     nxn   cinn  tail   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=66 nf=22
XM3     coutp nbc   nxp    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=12
XM4     coutn nbc   nxn    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=48 nf=12
XM5     coutp pbc   pxp    pxp    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=64 nf=16
XM6     coutn pbc   pxn    pxn    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=64 nf=16
XM7     pxp   vbp   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=40
XM8     pxn   vbp   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=40

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Common-mode feedback: differential-difference pair referenced to vcm.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMC1    cma    coutp scm  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMC2    cma    coutn scm  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMC3    vbp    vcm   scm  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMC4    vbp    vcm   scm  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMCT    scm    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=14 nf=4
XMPD    vbp    vbp   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMPD2   cma    cma   vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reset clock inverter (digital supply) and the complementary dummy devices
* that cancel the reset-switch clock feedthrough / channel-charge injection.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVN   samb  sam   vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XINVP   samb  sam   vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=9

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Summing-node reset switches and feedback capacitors.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XSWP    cinp  sam   vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=15
XSWN    cinn  sam   vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=15
XDUMP   cinp  samb  cinp  vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
XDUMN   cinn  samb  cinn  vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=10
CFP     cinp  coutp 63f
CFN     cinn  coutn 63f

.ends test_fct

circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Operation (fixture owned timing, cycle boundary at t=0 of each 1/900MHz period):
*   sam      high around the boundary : core input nodes are reset to vcm
*   transfer high 0.311..0.811 ns    : flying caps dump charge into cinp/cinn
*   sample_out high 0.081..0.801 ns  : fixture tracks / releases coutp/coutn
*
* Core: telescopic cascode fully differential OTA (NMOS input pair, NMOS
* cascode, PMOS current-source load).  cinp/cinn are the virtual-ground summing
* nodes; CFB* sets the charge-to-voltage gain C_MSB/CFB.  The input common mode
* is re-established every cycle by the sam switches to vcm, and the output
* common mode is re-established by the fixture precharge, so no CMFB is needed.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network: ib = 50 uA reference

* NMOS reference diode
XMBN ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* tail current mirror, 52.0 x -> 2.60 mA
XMT tailsrc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=520 nf=58
* 50 uA mirror leg that feeds the PMOS load-gate diode
XMBN2 nbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* PMOS load gate bias

* PMOS mirror leg into the NMOS cascode-gate diode
XMBP2 nbcn nbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.45 nf=1
* NMOS cascode gate bias
XMBNC nbcn nbcn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.56 nf=1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Telescopic cascode signal path
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS differential input pair, gates at the summing nodes
XM1 n1 cinp tailsrc vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=75
XM2 n2 cinn tailsrc vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=75

XMC2 coutn nbcn n2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=144 nf=36

XML1 coutp nbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=148 nf=32

* Charge-domain feedback capacitors and sam reset switches
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

CFBN cinn coutn 66f
XMRP cinp sam vcm vcm sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=20

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* TEST_FCT: 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge transfer residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* Single-stage telescopic OTA.  The fixture's flying capacitors (400 fF) are
* connected to cinn/cinp during "sam"; when they are re-connected to vcm the
* sampled charge is pushed into the summing nodes cinn/cinp, whose only
* capacitor to ac ground is the feedback capacitor C_f.  Charge conservation
* therefore gives a residue gain of C_fly/C_f, which is set by an ideal
* capacitor ratio and is process independent.
*
*   cinn/cinp : nmos lvt input pair (bulk tied to the tail node, no body effect)
*   tail      : nmos mirror (50 uA reference -> 1.84 mA)
*   cascodes  : nmos cascode (bias = 2 Vgs stack) + pmos cascode (gate at vss)
*   load      : pmos mirror from a pmos diode reference
*   cm bias   : the fixture precharges the outputs to 0.9 V every cycle, so the
*               output common mode is owned by the testbench.  What the stage
*               needs is a quiescent current balance in the output branch: the
*               pmos load is 20.4x the 50 uA reference while the input pair
*               draws 18.4x, so two 2x sinks (100 uA) mirrored off the same
*               ib reference make up the difference.
*   reset     : the fixture leaves cinn/cinp floating while it clamps the
*               flying-cap plates to vcm during "sam", so without a reset the
*               feedback charge is carried over from cycle to cycle and the
*               stage behaves as a leaky integrator (measured H(z) =
*               5.40/(1-0.836 z^-1) instead of a flat C_fly/C_f).  Two sam
*               switches discharge C_f while the fixture holds coutn/coutp at
*               the precharge level, so every cycle starts from a defined
*               state and the gain is the capacitor ratio at any tone.
*   dc path   : long triode resistor from cinn/cinp to vcm defines the summing
*               node dc level at start-up and during the transfer.
*
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* bias network
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* master nmos diode, 50 uA from the ib pin
XMBN   ib    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* nmos mirror that pushes 50 uA into the pmos diode reference
XMBN2  vbiasp ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* pmos diode reference -> vbp = vdd - |vgs_p| = 0.45 V
XMBP   vbiasp vbiasp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.3 nf=1
* pmos current source for the cascode bias stack
XMP2   vcn   vbiasp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.3 nf=1
* 2 x Vgs nmos diode stack -> vcn = 1.44 V (bias for the nmos cascode)
XMBN4  vcn   vcn   vx     vx     sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMBN3  vx    vx    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* tail current source: 1.84 mA
XMT    tail  ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=368 nf=8

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* input pair (lvt, low threshold keeps the tail node high enough)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1    bn    cinn  tail  tail  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=41 nf=4
XM2    bp    cinp  tail  tail  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=41 nf=4

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* cascodes
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMC1   coutn vcn   bn    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=34 nf=2
XMC2   coutp vcn   bp    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=34 nf=2
XMC3   coutn vssana an   an     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=29 nf=2
XMC4   coutp vssana ap   ap     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=29 nf=2

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* pmos current source load (1.02 mA per side)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
XML1   an    vbiasp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=108 nf=4
XML2   ap    vbiasp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=108 nf=4

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* output common-mode bias
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* The fixture precharges coutn/coutp to 0.9 V every cycle, so the output
* common mode is owned by the testbench; a common-mode feedback loop would
* only fight it (and its sense network would couple the differential output
* into the common-mode path).  What is needed instead is an accurate
* quiescent current balance in the output branch: the pmos load is 20.4x the
* 50 uA reference, the input pair draws 18.4x, so two 2x sinks (100 uA) are
* mirrored off the same ib reference to make up the difference.  Every branch
* is a geometric mirror of that one reference, so the balance, and with it
* the common-mode drift, tracks process and temperature.
XMI1   an    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XMI2   ap    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
* weak dc path from the outputs to vcm keeps the operating point well defined
XMR3   coutn vddana vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=0.42 nf=1
XMR4   coutp vddana vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=10 w=0.42 nf=1

*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
* feedback capacitors and input dc bias path
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
CF1    cinn  coutn 64f
CF2    cinp  coutp 64f
* reset switches (on during sam) discharge the feedback capacitors
XMRST1 cinn  sam   coutn coutn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMRST2 cinp  sam   coutp coutp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
* ~100 kohm triode resistor from the summing node to vcm (dc operating point)
XMR1   cinn  vddana vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XMR2   cinp  vddana vcm   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue amplifier core.
* Fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* Each half is an autozeroed CMOS-inverter charge integrator: Cint from the
* input gate (virtual ground) to the output, and a complementary pass-gate
* that shorts the input gate to the output during sam.  During sam the fixture
* precharges vout/cout to ~0.9 V; the autozero pass-gate lets the reset of the
* loop's two terminals track together, so the precharge step cannot pump charge
* into Cint through the input.  On transfer, the flying cap injects
* q = Cf*(vin - vcm) into the input gate; the inverter holds the gate at its
* trip point (virtual ground) and steers the charge into Cint: Av = -Cf/Cint.
* Long-L inverter devices keep the output impedance high so the integrated
* charge holds without droop between the track sample (0.78 ns) and the hold
* sample (0.801 ns).

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* Bias: diode-connected NMOS sinks the 50 uA reference on ib.
XIBD ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=2 nf=1

* Complement of sam for the PMOS half of each pass-gate.
XNINV sam_b sam vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPINV sam_b sam vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Positive half-cell.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP1 coutp cinp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XMN1 coutp cinp vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XAZN1 cinp sam coutp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XAZP1 cinp sam_b coutp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
CINT1 cinp coutp 66f

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Negative half-cell.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP2 coutn cinn vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
XMN2 coutn cinn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XAZN2 cinn sam coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XAZP2 cinn sam_b coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
CINT2 cinn coutn 66f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating-charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B.  Only PDK MOS wrappers and ideal capacitors are used.
*
* Topology:
*   - single-stage fully differential OTA: NMOS (lvt) input pair, PMOS (lvt)
*     current source loads, output common mode held by a slow CMFB servo.
*   - capacitive feedback C_fb (cinp->coutp, cinn->coutn) sets the charge gain.
*   - during "sam" the summing nodes are reset to vcm and the outputs are reset
*     to the summing nodes, so every cycle starts from a defined charge state.
*   - very high value PMOS "pseudo resistors" give the floating summing nodes a
*     DC path to vcm for the operating point solve (negligible charge leakage).

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network (50uA in on ib) ----------------
* NMOS diode reference
XMB1      ib      ib      vssana  vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* CMFB error amplifier tail (0.2x = 10uA)
XMB3      etail   ib      vssana  vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- differential input pair and tail source ----------------
XM1       coutp   cinp    tailn   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=150 nf=6
XM2       coutn   cinn    tailn   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=150 nf=6
XM3       tailn   ib      vssana  vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=200 nf=8

* ---------------- PMOS current source loads ----------------
XM6       coutp   pgate   vddana  vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.35 w=100 nf=4
XM7       coutn   pgate   vddana  vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.35 w=100 nf=4

* ---------------- charge feedback capacitors ----------------
CFBP      coutp   cinp    66.7f
CFBN      coutn   cinn    66.7f

* ---------------- summing node DC path (pseudo resistors to vcm) ----------------
XR3       cinp    vssana  vcm     vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=20 w=0.42 nf=1
XR4       cinn    vssana  vcm     vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=20 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---------------- reset switches (transmission gates, driven by sam) ----------------
* summing node -> vcm
XSN1      cinp    sam     vcm     vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSP1      cinp    samb    vcm     vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XSN2      cinn    sam     vcm     vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSP2      cinn    samb    vcm     vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* summing node -> output (discharge feedback cap, define output during sam)
XSN3      cinp    sam     coutp   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSP3      cinp    samb    coutp   vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XSN4      cinn    sam     coutn   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XSP4      cinn    samb    coutn   vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* sam inverter for the PMOS gates
XIN1      samb    sam     vssana  vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIP1      samb    sam     vddana  vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

* ---------------- common mode feedback ----------------
* sense network: long channel PMOS devices used as very large resistors
XR1       coutp   vssana  s1      vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
XR2       coutn   vssana  s1      vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=4 w=0.42 nf=1
CS1       s1      vssana  1p
* error amplifier: NMOS pair (sense vs vcm), PMOS mirror load, drives load gates
XM8       e1      s1      etail   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XM9       pgate   vcm     etail   vssana  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XM11      e1      e1      vddana  vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM12      pgate   e1      vddana  vddana  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CC2       pgate   vssana  20p

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* TEST_FCT v6 - differential SC residue amplifier (MDAC) - telescopic OTA
* Charge-transfer gain = C_sampling/C_feedback via ideal cap ratio (6.25).
* Fully-differential telescopic OTA: NMOS-LVT diff pair + NMOS cascodes +
* PMOS current-mirror loads + PMOS cascodes.  High output impedance keeps
* loop gain large so the charge-transfer gain converges to Cfly/Cfb.
* Outputs are the DUT ports coutp/coutn (cascode drains).
* NMOS pair runs near the current-limit; currents derive from the 50uA ib
* reference: tail 1.4 mA, PMOS bias diode chain 175 uA via XMNSTACK.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------- bias reference: 50uA NMOS diode ----------
XMREF ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------- tail current source: 28x reference (~1.4 mA) ----------
XMTAIL tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=8

* ---------- input differential pair -> pair-drain nodes ----------
XMPAIRP npairp cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=8
XMPAIRN npairn cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=8

* ---------- NMOS cascodes -> output ports ----------
XMN5P coutp vbn_c npairp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XMN5N coutn vbn_c npairn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4

* ---------- PMOS cascode gates vbp_c/vbp from two-diode supply stack -----
XMNSTACK vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMPB vbp vbp vbp_c vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=35 nf=5
XMPC vbp_c vbp_c vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=35 nf=5

* ---------- PMOS loads (current mirrors of XMPB) ----------
XM3P pmidp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=14
XM3N pmidn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=14

* ---------- PMOS cascodes -> output ports ----------
XM4P coutp vbp_c pmidp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=70 nf=10
XM4N coutn vbp_c pmidn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=70 nf=10

* ---------- NMOS cascode gate vbn_c: two-diode ladder ----------
XMNC1 vbn_c vbn_c vbnc_mid vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMNC2 vbnc_mid vbnc_mid vbnc_low vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMNCBIAS vbnc_low ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- feedback caps: same-side, gain = Cfly/Cfb ----------
CFBA cinp coutp 64f
CFBB cinn coutn 64f

* ---------- reset switches (sam) ----------
XSWINP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSWINN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSWOUT coutn sam coutp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Topology: NMOS-input differential pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS current-source
* load + PMOS cascode, with capacitive feedback (Cfb) that sets the closed-loop
* charge gain to Cfly/Cfb ~ 6. During `transfer` the fixture dumps the flying-
* capacitor charge into cinn/cinp; the core holds cinn/cinp at a virtual ground
* near vcm and drives coutn/coutp. During the reset phase (transfer=0) LVT-PMOS
* switches tie cinn/cinp/coutn/coutp back to vcm to discharge Cfb and re-bias
* the virtual ground. Only MOS devices and ideal capacitors are used.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* --- Bias generation (all from the 50 uA `ib` reference) -------------------
* ib : diode-connected NMOS, gate bias for the NMOS tail current source.
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* pbias : PMOS diode referenced through a 1:1 NMOS mirror -> PMOS load bias.
XMB1 pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMB2 pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
* ncas : NMOS cascode bias from a small diode NMOS at 50 uA.
XMB3 ncas pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XMB4 ncas ncas vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
* pcas : PMOS cascode bias from a diode PMOS at 50 uA.
XMB5 pcas pcas vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMB6 pcas ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* --- OTA: diff pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS current-source + PMOS cascode -----
* Tail current source (~32 x 50 uA = 1.6 mA).
XMT tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=32
* Input pair (gates are the charge-transfer virtual-ground nodes).
XMIN_P dp cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=16
XMIN_N dn cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=16
* NMOS cascode devices.
XMNC_P coutp ncas dp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=130 nf=12
XMNC_N coutn ncas dn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=130 nf=12
* PMOS current-source loads.
XML_P outp_pload pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=310 nf=24
XML_N outn_pload pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=310 nf=24
* PMOS cascode devices (raise the output impedance for accurate gain).
XMPC_P coutp pcas outp_pload vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=16
XMPC_N coutn pcas outn_pload vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=16

* --- Feedback capacitors (ideal, internal functional capacitors) -----------
CFB_P coutp cinp 72f
CFB_N coutn cinn 72f

* --- Reset switches: LVT PMOS, on when transfer=0 --------------------------
* Tie virtual ground and output nodes back to vcm during the reset phase so
* Cfb is discharged and the virtual ground starts every transfer at vcm.
XMRIN_P cinp transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1
XMRIN_N cinn transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1
XMROUT_P coutp transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1
XMROUT_N coutn transfer vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* Top-level boundary (must not change):
*   cinn cinp  - virtual-ground / charge-transfer inputs
*   coutn coutp - amplified differential outputs
*   ib         - 50 uA reference current (sink)
*   sam        - sample / reset phase (DUT copy)
*   transfer   - charge-transfer phase (DUT copy)
*   vcm        - 1.0 V input common-mode reference
*   vddana/vdddig - 1.8 V supplies, vssana/vssdig - grounds
*
* MOS terminal order: D G S B.  SKY130 scale=1u so l/w are in micrometres.
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* A folded-cascode fully differential OTA (NMOS input pair) implements the
* active core.  Feedback capacitors Cfb (66.7 fF) are permanently wired between
* the outputs and the virtual-ground inputs, giving a closed-loop differential
* gain of Cfly/Cfb = 400f/66.7f = 6.0 V/V when the fixture's 400 fF flying caps
* dump their sampled charge during `transfer`.
*
* During `sam` the virtual grounds cinn/cinp are reset to vcm through NMOS
* switches; the fixture precharges the outputs to 0.9 V.  The OTA is biased from
* the 50 uA `ib` reference with a wide-swing PMOS cascode bias generator.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network (all mirrors refer to the 50 uA `ib` diode).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS reference diode: sinks the 50 uA from `ib` (ib node = nbias).
XBN0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* PMOS reference: an NMOS mirror pulls 50 uA through a PMOS diode -> pbias.
XBNP0 pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XBP0 pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* PMOS cascode bias (wide swing): mirror + diode stack, sunk by an NMOS mirror.
XBPC1 pb_sw pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XBPC2 pcasc pcasc pb_sw vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=1
XBNB pcasc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Folded-cascode OTA (NMOS input, crossed outputs for negative feedback).
*   coutp = +A*(cinp - cinn), coutn = -A*(cinp - cinn)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Tail current source (gate = ib = nbias), 20x ib = 1 mA.
XT0 vtail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=104 nf=17
* Input pair.
XINP fold_p cinp vtail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=104 nf=16
XINN fold_n cinn vtail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=104 nf=16
* PMOS current sources into the folded nodes.
XPL_P fold_p pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=208 nf=35
XPL_N fold_n pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=208 nf=35
* PMOS cascodes (crossed: coutn on cinp side, coutp on cinn side).
XPC_P coutn pcasc fold_p vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=16
XPC_N coutp pcasc fold_n vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=16
* NMOS output current sources.
XNB_P coutn ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=42 nf=7
XNB_N coutp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=42 nf=7

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Starter for the Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier task.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

* Fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
*
* Operation: during `sam` the core clamps its input virtual-ground nodes
* (cinn/cinp) to `vcm`; the bench owns the output precharge, so the outputs
* are re-set to the precharge level each cycle.  During `transfer` the bench
* connects the 400 fF flying capacitors between `vcm` and cinn/cinp; the
* differential charge is integrated onto the internal feedback caps
* (Cfb ~= C_fly/6) through a high-gain telescopic OTA, producing a sampled
* differential gain of C_fly/Cfb with a common-mode output near the
* output-precharge level.
*
* Gain architecture (current-matched telescopic):
*  - NMOS input pair (short LVT channel -> low gate capacitance, fast).
*  - NMOS cascode above each pair drain (boosts output impedance, so the
*    short-L pair does not limit open-loop gain; gate biased by a fixed
*    corner-stable resistive divider).
*  - Long-L PMOS current-source loads.  Their gate (pbias) is generated by a
*    current mirror that carries the *branch* current, so the load current
*    matches the pair/tail current exactly -> the output common mode is held
*    after the bench precharge releases (no CM collapse).
*
* All passives here are ideal functional capacitors (allowed by the task)
* plus physical poly resistors for the two fixed bias taps (PDK models).

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias reference: NMOS diode on ib absorbs the 50 uA bench reference and
* generates the shared NMOS bias voltage (its gate node = ib).
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMBN   ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2

* Tail current source for the input differential pair (x20 mirror: ~1 mA).
XMTAIL tailn ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top PMOS current-source load + mirror reference.
* The reference branch carries I_ref and its gate/diode (pbias) sets the
* load devices.  Load W/L = 4 x reference W/L so each load takes the full
* branch current for a 4x smaller bias current (power savings).
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMPD   pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=17 nf=3
XMPDN  pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

XML3N  coutn pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=68 nf=10
XML3P  coutp pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=68 nf=10

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input reset clamps: hold the virtual-ground nodes at vcm during `sam` so
* that each transfer starts from a known reference.
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
XS1 cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=6
XS2 cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=6

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fully differential telescopic OTA.
*  - Input pair (LVT NMOS, short L for low gate capacitance).
*  - NMOS cascodes above the pair drains (gate: ncas) boost the output
*    impedance of the short-L pair to a large value.
*  - The pair drains (ndp/ndn) float one cascade Vgs below the output.
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1N ndp cinn tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=72 nf=12
XM1P ndn cinp tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=72 nf=12

XMC2N coutp ncas ndp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=58 nf=10
XMC2P coutn ncas ndn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=58 nf=10

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed cascade gate bias (ncas ~ V(out)=0.9 + Vgs(cascode) ~ 1.27 V).
* Poly resistors are corner-stable, so ncas stays fixed across process
* corners; the two cascade devices then saturate with margin over the whole
* corner span (the pair Vds and cascade Vds only trade off by the Vt shift).
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
XR1 vddana ncas vssana sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=40
XR2 ncas vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=92
CND ncas vssana 2p

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Internal feedback (integration) capacitors, cross coupled.
* C_fly 400 fF; gain = C_fly/Cfb = 6.0 -> Cfb ~ 66.7 fF.
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
CPB cinp coutn 71.5e-15
CPN cinn coutp 71.5e-15

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Analog Arena 900 MS/s fully-differential floating charge-transfer (FCT)
* residue amplifier - transistor-level core.
*
* Topology: telescopic OTA with regular-NMOS input pair (minimum L for low gate
* capacitance, body tied to source to kill body effect), regular-NMOS cascode,
* LVT-NMOS tail current source, and a long-channel regular-PMOS current-source
* load (high output resistance, no PMOS cascode bias needed).  Closed in an SC
* gain of C_s/C_f via feedback caps C_f.  During "sam" the core is reset by CMOS
* transmission gates: each input is tied to vcm and each output is tied back to
* its input (unity gain), establishing the virtual ground at vcm and
* discharging C_f.  During "transfer" (sam low) the fixture connects the flying
* caps to the OTA inputs and the core amplifies.

* MOS terminal order: D G S B.  Ideal capacitors are allowed for C_f.

Xp a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=2
Xn a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3 nf=1
.ends fct_tg

* reset clock
Xinv sam samb vdddig vssdig fct_inv

* --- bias network, referenced to the 50 uA sourced into ib ---

* PMOS mirror reference: copy the 50 uA into a regular-PMOS diode (Vbp).

Xmpref   vbp  vbp  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=1   w=8 nf=2

Xmnb_vbnc vbnc vbnc vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1   w=1  nf=1

* --- OTA: telescopic cascode, NMOS input ---
* tail current source (LVT)
Xmtail tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=220 nf=44
* input pair (regular NMOS, body tied to source)

Xm2 d2 cinn tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=30

Xm4 coutn vbnc d2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=50 nf=10

Xm5 coutp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24
Xm6 coutn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=24

Cfbp coutp cinp 62f
Cfbn coutn cinn 62f

Xsw_cmp cinp  vcm  sam samb vddana vssana fct_tg
Xsw_cmn cinn  vcm  sam samb vddana vssana fct_tg
