taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* FCT floating charge-transfer residue amplifier core (TEST_FCT).
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture: fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA.
*   gnd - LVT NMOS tail - LVT NMOS input pair (gates at cin ~1.0 V) -
*   LVT NMOS cascodes - outputs - LVT PMOS cascodes - LVT PMOS top
*   sources - vdd.
* The series legs carry a matched standing current so the output common
* mode is intrinsically stable (no CMFB needed); the input pair steers
* signal charge into the output caps.
*  - Feedback capacitors CF between cin and cout: closed-loop charge gain
*    Cfly/CF ~ 400/67 ~ 6 V/V (Cfly = bench-owned 400 fF flying caps).
*  - sam-phase transmission-gate reset switches short each output to its
*    input, auto-zeroing the OTA every cycle.
*  - Bias: the 50 uA ib pin sinks an LVT NMOS diode (tail reference).
*    A matched 50 uA PMOS diode branch sets pbias (PMOS top gates).
*    Two 50 uA replica branches replicate the top and bottom signal
*    halves at 1:14 scale with diode-connected cascodes; their diode
*    gates are the NMOS/PMOS cascode bias voltages and track process.
*    The replica cascodes run at half current density so the signal
*    cascodes retain saturation margin across the output swing.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- Feedback (charge-transfer) capacitors ----
CFN cinn coutn 67f
CFP cinp coutp 67f

* ---- sam-phase auto-zero reset transmission gates ----
XRSTN_N cinn  sam      coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XRSTN_P cinn  sam_rstn coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XRSTP_N cinp  sam      coutp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XRSTP_P cinp  sam_rstn coutp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* Inverter making sam_rstn = ~sam for the PMOS reset gates.
XINV_N sam_rstn sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINV_P sam_rstn sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---- Bias references (50 uA each branch; density ~5 uA/um, L=0.35) ----
* B1: NMOS tail-gate diode on the ib pin.
XBND ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
* B2: PMOS top-gate diode, sinked by an ib-mirrored NMOS.
XD1  pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XSK2 pbias ib     vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
* B3: top-half replica: PMOS top mirror -> PMOS cascode diode (half
*     density, w=20) -> NMOS sink.  Sets pcasc.
XTP3  pcd   pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XPCD  pcasc pcasc pcd    vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XSK3  pcasc ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
* B4: bottom-half replica: PMOS feed -> NMOS cascode diode (half
*     density, w=20) -> NMOS pair diode -> NMOS tail mirror.  Sets ncas.
XTP4  ncas  pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XNCD  ncas  ncas  n1d   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XNPD  n1d   n1d   std   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XNTD  std   ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=2

* ---- Telescopic cascode legs (700 uA standing each, 14x mirrors) ----
* NMOS tail.
XTAIL stail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
* LVT NMOS input pair.
XINN n1 cinn stail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
XINP n2 cinp stail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
* NMOS cascodes.
XCNN coutn ncas n1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
XCNP coutp ncas n2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
* PMOS cascodes.
XCPN coutn pcasc pcn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
XCPP coutp pcasc pcp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
* PMOS top current sources.
XPTN pcn pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14
XPTP pcp pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=140 nf=14

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* TEST_FCT: fully-differential floating charge-transfer residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture
*   The bench-owned 400 fF flying caps and the internal crossed 70 fF
*   feedback caps form a capacitive-feedback sampled gain stage with ideal
*   gain Cfly/Cfb = 400/70 = 5.71 V/V.  The active core is a two-stage
*   fully-differential amplifier:
*     Stage 1: lvt NMOS differential pair (gates = cinn/cinp virtual
*              grounds) with diode-connected PMOS loads; the diodes firmly
*              define the stage-1 output common mode, so no CMFB is needed
*              around stage 1.
*     Stage 2: NMOS common-source outputs with PMOS current loads whose
*              gates are driven by a switched-capacitor CMFB loop pinning
*              the output common mode to vcm.
*   Both stages invert, so cinn/cinp -> coutn/coutp is non-inverting and
*   the feedback caps are crossed (cinp->coutn, cinn->coutp).
*   A self-consistent replica branch copies stage 1 (lvt NMOS with gate at
*   vcm, diode PMOS load) and the stage-2 stack to generate vref2, the
*   precharge reference for the CMFB PMOS gate.  ib (50 uA) feeds the
*   nbias NMOS diode that mirrors the stage-1 tail and replica tails, and a
*   branch feeding the pbias PMOS mirror.  sam-phase transmission gates
*   precharge cinn/cinp and coutn/coutp to vcm every cycle.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- samn: inverted sam for the PMOS reset gates (digital supply) ----
XMINV samn sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMPINV samn sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

* ---- Bias network ----
* nbias: NMOS diode carrying the 50 uA reference
XMNID ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
* pbias: 50 uA NMOS mirror into a PMOS diode
XMNBP pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XMPD pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

* ---- Self-consistent replica for vref2 (the stage-2 PMOS-gate reference) ----
* Replica tail and lvt input device with gate at vcm -> same Vg as stage 1
XMNRTR str ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=6
XMNRIN apr vcm str vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
XMPRLD apr apr vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
* Replica stage-2 stack: NMOS gate at apr (natural stage-1 CM), PMOS diode
XMN2R vref2 apr vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XMP2R vref2 vref2 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4

* ---- Stage 1: lvt NMOS differential pair, diode-connected PMOS loads ----
XMNTAIL st ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=96 nf=12
XMNIP ap cinp st vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
XMNIN an cinn st vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=48 nf=8
XMPLDP ap ap vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPLDN an an vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ---- Stage 2: NMOS common-source outputs, PMOS loads gated by CMFB ----
XMN2P coutp ap vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XMN2N coutn an vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=10 nf=2
XMP2P coutp vcmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XMP2N coutn vcmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4

* ---- Switched-capacitor CMFB on the output stage ----
CCMFP coutp vcmfb 150f
CCMFN coutn vcmfb 150f
* sam refresh: precharge vcmfb to the replica reference vref2
XCMFBN vcmfb sam vref2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XCMFBP vcmfb samn vref2 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---- sam-phase reset transmission gates ----
* Inputs (virtual grounds) reset to vcm
XRSTNP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XRSTNPP cinp samn vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XRSTNN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XRSTNNP cinn samn vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* Outputs reset to vcm (strong TGs: they override stage 2 during sam)
XRSTOPN coutp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRSTOPP coutp samn vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XRSTONN coutn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRSTONP coutn samn vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2

* ---- Crossed feedback capacitors (ideal gain = Cfly/Cfb = 400/70 ~ 5.7) ----
CFBP cinp coutn 70f
CFBN cinn coutp 70f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* TEST_FCT: fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
*
* Operation:
*   sam high      : on-chip CMOS transmission gates precharge the floating
*                   input gates (cinn/cinp) to vcm. The fixture simultaneously
*                   holds its flying-capacitor plates at vcm and precharges the
*                   held outputs (and, through the closed track switch, coutn/p)
*                   to vocm, so the feedback capacitors are fully reset.
*   transfer high : the fixture reconnects its 400 fF flying caps between vcm
*                   and cinn/cinp; stored charge drives the amplifier inputs. A
*                   fully differential OTA with capacitive feedback settles to
*                   the amplified residue while the fixture tracks coutn/coutp
*                   onto voutn/voutp.
* Sampled gain is set by the ideal Cfly/Cfb ratio: 400 fF / 64 fF = 6.25 V/V.
*
* Amplifier: NMOS input pair (short L, for low input-gate capacitance) with an
* NMOS cascode, feeding long-L PMOS current-source loads (long L is free here -
* the load gates are AC ground). Every bias leg is an exact 1:20 width-scaled
* replica (same l, same current density, ~50 uA per leg) of the amplifier
* device it biases, so all signal devices stay saturated near the 0.9 V
* precharge. Only MOS devices and ideal capacitors are used.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- bias reference: external source injects 50 uA into ib; a diode LVT NMOS
* sinks it, defining the master NMOS mirror gate.
XIB_D  ib    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.0 nf=2

* ---- PMOS load-gate leg (50 uA): long-L diode LVT PMOS (1:20 replica of the
* amplifier loads) defines bp; an ib-mirror NMOS sinks the leg current.
XPD1   bp    bp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=4.0 nf=2
XPNSNK bp    ib    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.0 nf=2

* ---- tail-gate leg (50 uA): bp-mirror PMOS replica sources into a diode
* LVT NMOS replica of the tail, defining bts.
XPTSRC bts   bp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=4.0 nf=2
XNTD   bts   bts   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.4 nf=2

* ---- NMOS-cascode-gate leg (50 uA): bp-mirror PMOS replica sources into a
* 1:20 replica of the amplifier bottom stack: diode cascode (bnc), vcm-gated
* input replica, bts-gated tail replica.
XBNSRC bnc   bp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=4.0 nf=2
XNCD   bnc   bnc   nrx    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XNR    nrx   vcm   nrxs   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XNRT   nrxs  bts   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.4 nf=2

* ---- OTA (tail ~2 mA, ~1 mA per side). Explicit drain areas are kept small to
* minimise parasitic capacitance on the charge-transfer and output nodes.
* tail current source
XNTS   xtail bts   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=32
+ as=20 ad=20 ps=200 pd=200
* input differential pair (gates are the floating charge-transfer nodes)
XMN1   xd1   cinn  xtail  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=20
+ as=12 ad=12 ps=120 pd=120
XMN2   xd2   cinp  xtail  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=20
+ as=12 ad=12 ps=120 pd=120
* NMOS cascodes
XMNC1  coutn bnc   xd1    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=20
+ as=12 ad=12 ps=120 pd=120
XMNC2  coutp bnc   xd2    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=20
+ as=12 ad=12 ps=120 pd=120
* long-L PMOS current-source loads (high ro; gates at AC ground)
XMP1   coutn bp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=80 nf=10
+ as=10 ad=10 ps=120 pd=120
XMP2   coutp bp    vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=80 nf=10
+ as=10 ad=10 ps=120 pd=120

* ---- feedback capacitors: sampled gain = Cfly/Cfb = 400f/64f = 6.25 V/V
CFBP   cinp  coutp 64f
CFBN   cinn  coutn 64f

* ---- sam-phase reset: inverter on the digital supply drives the PMOS gate of
* each CMOS transmission gate; sam directly drives the NMOS gate. The TGs tie
* the floating input gates to vcm while sam is high.
XINVP  samb  sam   vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XINVN  samb  sam   vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XRSTPN cinp  sam   vcm    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XRSTPP cinp  samb  vcm    vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XRSTNN cinn  sam   vcm    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XRSTNP cinn  samb  vcm    vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2

* ---- bias-rail hold capacitors (stiffen bias nodes through clocked phases)
CBTS   bts   vssana 400f
CBNC   bnc   vssana 400f
CBP    bp    vddana 400f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier core
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* =========================================================================
* 1. Digital Clock Buffer / Inverter for Reset Phase (sam -> sam_b, sam_buf)
* =========================================================================
XINV1_P sam_b sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=1
XINV1_N sam_b sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=1

XINV2_P sam_buf sam_b vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=1
XINV2_N sam_buf sam_b vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=1

* Keep transfer port properly terminated
XMTR_DUM transfer vssdig vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

* =========================================================================
* 2. Bias Network from 50 uA Reference (ib)
* =========================================================================
* Master NMOS diode (50 uA)
XMBIAS_N ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=8.0 nf=1

* PMOS cascode bias generator (50 uA branch): sets vbpcasc so pcascp ~ 1.50 V
XMBIAS_PCASC_N vbpcasc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=8.0 nf=1
XMBIAS_PCASC_P vbpcasc vbpcasc vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=3.5 nf=1

* Fixed PMOS load bias generator (50 uA branch)
XMBIAS_PFIX_N vbp_fix ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=8.0 nf=1
XMBIAS_PFIX_P vbp_fix vbp_fix vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=12.0 nf=1

* NMOS cascode bias generator: sets vbncasc ~ 1.15 V so ncascp ~ 0.48 V
XMBIAS_NCASC_P vbncasc vbp_fix vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=12.0 nf=1
XMBIAS_NCASC_TOP vbncasc vbncasc vbn_mid vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28.0 nf=1
XMBIAS_NCASC_BOT vbn_mid vbn_mid vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28.0 nf=1

* =========================================================================
* 3. Fully Differential Telescopic Cascode Core (I_tail = 1.6 mA, 800 uA/side)
* =========================================================================
* Tail current source: 32x * 50 uA = 1.6 mA
XMTAIL ntail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=256.0 nf=1

* NMOS differential input pair (LVT for maximum gm and Vds headroom on tail)
XMINP ncascp cinp ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160.0 nf=1
XMINN ncascn cinn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160.0 nf=1

* NMOS cascode pair (LVT with gate at vbncasc ~ 1.15 V -> ncascp ~ 0.48 V)
XMCASCN_P coutp vbncasc ncascp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=64.0 nf=1
XMCASCN_N coutn vbncasc ncascn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=64.0 nf=1

* PMOS cascode pair (SVT with gate at vbpcasc)
XMCASCP_P coutp vbpcasc pcascp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56.0 nf=1
XMCASCP_N coutn vbpcasc pcascn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56.0 nf=1

* PMOS top current sources: fixed mirror + CMFB mirror (sized for CM ~ 0.92 V)
XMLOADP_FIX pcascp vbp_fix vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=144.0 nf=1
XMLOADN_FIX pcascn vbp_fix vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=144.0 nf=1

XMLOADP_CM pcascp vbp_cm vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=64.0 nf=1
XMLOADN_CM pcascn vbp_cm vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=64.0 nf=1

* =========================================================================
* 4. Continuous-Time Split-Pair Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB)
* =========================================================================
* CMFB tail current: 3x * 50 uA = 150 uA (75 uA per side at equilibrium)
XMCM_TAIL ncm_tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=24.0 nf=1

* Sense coutp and coutn
XMCM_INP vddana coutp ncm_tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.40 w=8.0 nf=1
XMCM_INN vddana coutn ncm_tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.40 w=8.0 nf=1

* Reference transistor at vcm = 1.0 V driving diode-connected PMOS load
XMCM_REF vbp_cm vcm ncm_tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.40 w=14.0 nf=1
XMCM_DIODE vbp_cm vbp_cm vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=20.0 nf=1

* =========================================================================
* 5. Reset Switches during sam Phase
* =========================================================================
* Shunt differential cascode nodes during sam to eliminate Miller effect during reset
XMSW_NCASCD ncascp sam_buf ncascn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=1

* Reset cinp and cinn to vcm (low-capacitance complementary switches)
XMSW_INP_N cinp sam_buf vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=1
XMSW_INP_P cinp sam_b vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1

XMSW_INN_N cinn sam_buf vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=1
XMSW_INN_P cinn sam_b vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1

* Differential short between cinp and cinn during sam
XMSW_IND_N cinp sam_buf cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=1
XMSW_IND_P cinp sam_b cinn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=1

* Differential short between coutp and coutn during sam
XMSW_OUTD_N coutp sam_buf coutn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=1
XMSW_OUTD_P coutp sam_b coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=1

* =========================================================================
* 6. Charge-Transfer Feedback Capacitors
* =========================================================================
CFBP cinp coutp 60f
CFBN cinn coutn 60f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier core
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Starter for the Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier task.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

* Implement only the transistor-level TEST_FCT core. The public and final
* testbenches own the sampler, flying capacitors, output precharge, and output
* track-and-hold fixture. Ideal switches, relays, independent/controlled
* sources, and behavioural active elements are not legal in this deliverable.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

*==========================================================================
* 900 MS/s floating-charge-transfer (FCT) residue-amplifier core.
*
* Operation (fixture-owned phases, see task spec):
*   sam       : fixture resamples vinp/vinn onto the 400 fF flying caps and
*               holds their output plates at vcm; the DUT clamps its summing
*               nodes cinp/cinn to vcm here (reset).
*   transfer  : fixture ties the flying-cap input plates to vcm and the output
*               plates to cinp/cinn.  The DUT virtual-ground OTA absorbs the
*               transferred differential charge onto the feedback caps CFp/CFn
*               and develops coutp/coutp.  Gain = Cfly/CF = 400f/64f ~= 6.25.
*
* Topology: fully-differential NMOS-input telescopic cascode OTA.
*   - Diode-referenced bias network mirrored from the 50 uA ib reference so the
*     cascode biases track Vth+Vov across corners.
*   - Continuous CMFB (NMOS common-source output-CM sensor + inverting stage)
*     driving the top PMOS current sources, holding the output common mode.
*   - Ideal capacitors (allowed) for the functional feedback caps and CMFB
*     compensation only.
*==========================================================================

*----- bias / reference network (all 50 uA reference branches mirror ib) -----
* ib reference diode: the fixture pulls 50 uA out of ib; this diode sinks it
* and defines the NMOS bias voltage on node ib.
XMD_ib  ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* pbias: PMOS bias.  M_ns1 sinks 50 uA from pbias; M_pd diode sets pbias.
XMNs1 pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPd  pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* ncas: NMOS cascode bias (two stacked NMOS diode drops ~= 1.2-1.3 V), fed by a
* 50 uA PMOS source.  Gives the input-pair drain enough headroom for sat.
XMPf1 ncas pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMNa  ncas ncas nb1   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNb  nb1  nb1  vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* pcas: PMOS cascode bias (two stacked PMOS diode drops below vdd ~= 0.5 V).
XMNs2 pcas ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPa  pcas pcas pb1   vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMPb  pb1  pb1  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

*----- telescopic-cascode core (NMOS input, diff outputs coutp/coutn) --------
* tail current source (~1.25 mA total): 25x the 50 uA reference
XMT  tail_n ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=10
* input pair (gates = summing/virtual-ground nodes cinp/cinn)
XMIp dp   cinp tail_n vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XMIn dn   cinn tail_n vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
* NMOS cascode (gates = ncas)
XMCn coutn ncas dn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
XMCp coutp ncas dp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=10
* PMOS cascode (gates = pcas), sources = ep/en
XMQp coutp pcas ep vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=16
XMQn coutn pcas en vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=16
* top PMOS current sources (gates = cmfb); each sources ~0.6 mA
XMSp ep cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=64 nf=10
XMSn en cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=64 nf=10

*----- continuous common-mode feedback (drives XMSp/XMSn) -------------------
* output-CM sensor: two NMOS common-source devices (gates = outputs) pull
* current out of cmfb_s; PMOS Msp pushes a reference current in.  cmfb_s falls
* as output CM rises.
XMSa cmfb_s coutp vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMSb cmfb_s coutn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMSr cmfb_s pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* inverting stage: cmfb_s down -> cmfb up -> XMSp/XMSn conduct less -> CM down.
XMIn_c cmfb cmfb_s vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMIp_c cmfb pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
CCmfb cmfb vssana 20f

*----- feedback capacitors (gain = Cfly/CF, Cfly = 400 fF) ------------------
CFp cinp coutp 64f
CFn cinn coutn 64f

*----- reset: clamp summing nodes to vcm during sam (NMOS pass, gate = sam) --
XMRp cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XMRn cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

.ends test_fct

circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully-differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
* Only the transistor-level TEST_FCT core. The bench owns the flying capacitors,
* sampler/transfer switches, output precharge, output track-and-hold, and loads.
*
* Architecture: always-on telescopic cascode OTA, capacitive feedback sets gain
* (Cfly/Cf ~ 6).  cinp/cinn reset to vcm during sam.  SC CMFB regulates output
* common mode to vcm.  Ideal capacitors are the only allowed non-MOS elements.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ============ bias references (from 50uA ib) ============
* NMOS master diode: nref = ib = Vgs_n(50uA)
XMref ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* PMOS reference diode pref: 50uA sunk by NMOS mirror of ib
XMpmir pref ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMpref pref pref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* ncas (NMOS cascode gate) = Vth+2*Vov : PMOS 4x source into NMOS diode (same as Mref)
XMp4xsrc ncas pref vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XMncasd ncas ncas vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* pcas (PMOS cascode gate) = vdd-(Vthp+2*Vovp) : NMOS 4x sink from PMOS diode
XMn4xsnk pcas ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XMpcasd pcas pcas vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* ============ telescopic core ============
* NMOS tail current source (mirror of ib)
XMtail tailn ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=30
* NMOS input pair
XMinp dp cinp tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XMinn dn cinn tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* NMOS cascode
XMcasnp coutp ncas dp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XMcasnn coutn ncas dn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* PMOS load (gate = cmfb, CMFB controlled)
XMloadp pmidp cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=40
XMloadn pmidn cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=40
* PMOS cascode
XMpcasp coutp pcas pmidp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=40
XMpcasn coutn pcas pmidn vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=300 nf=40

* ============ feedback capacitors (gain = Cfly/Cf = 400f/66f ~ 6) ============
Cfp coutp cinp 66f
Cfn coutn cinn 66f

* ============ input reset switches: cinp/cinn -> vcm during sam ============
XMrst_p cinp vcm sam vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMrst_n cinn vcm sam vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

* ============ SC CMFB: sense output CM, regulate PMOS load gates ============
Ccm1 coutp cmfb 20f
Ccm2 coutn cmfb 20f
XMrst_cmfb cmfb vcm sam vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Starter for the Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier task.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Fully-differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* Two single-ended inverting charge amplifiers (5T OTA + capacitive feedback)
* give a ratio-defined differential gain = C_fly / C_f.  Each output common
* mode is self-referenced to vcm: the reset transmission gate across each C_f
* discharges it during every non-transfer phase, so each output starts transfer
* at the virtual-ground value (vcm).  Gain set by capacitor ratio -> corner
* robust.  Ideal C is permitted for the internal feedback capacitors.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* --- 50 uA reference -> NMOS diode bias on node ib (strong inversion) ---
XMBIAS ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4

* === Channel P: inverting charge amplifier (input cinp, output coutp) ===
XM1P coutp cinp tailp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XM2P diodp vcm tailp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
*
* Architecture: telescopic fully differential OTA (low-Vt NMOS input pair,
* NMOS cascodes, PMOS current-source loads) with cross-coupled capacitive
* feedback around the cinn/cinp summing nodes.  The testbench flying
* capacitors (400 fF) dump their sampled charge into the summing nodes
* during transfer while the OTA holds them at vcm, so the closed-loop
* sampled gain is set by the capacitor ratio Cfly/Cf.
*
* The sam phase resets both summing nodes to vcm (the same reference the
* flying plates are precharged to, so the transfer connection is
* kick-free) while the fixture precharges the outputs to vocm.
*
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk).  l and w are in
* micrometres (SKY130 library scale=1u).

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Amplifier core (telescopic, NMOS-input)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Tail current source: mirrors the 50 uA reference at ~36:1.
XTAIL ntail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=40
* Differential input pair.  Low-Vt devices keep the tail node low enough
* to stay saturated with the ~1.0 V input common mode.
XINP nxp cinp ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XINN nxn cinn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
* NMOS cascodes.
XCASP coutn vcasn nxp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XCASN coutp vcasn nxn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
* PMOS current-source loads (long L for output resistance).
XLOADP vddana vbp coutn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
XLOADN vddana vbp coutp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Capacitive feedback: sampled differential gain = 400 fF / 63 fF
* (cross-coupled for negative feedback with the NMOS input pair).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
CFP cinp coutn 63f
CFN cinn coutp 63f

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Summing-node reset: pin cinn/cinp to vcm while sam is high.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRSTP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XRSTN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* Very weak MOS "resistors" to vcm so the otherwise floating summing
* nodes keep a defined DC operating point (megohm range: they do not
* disturb the charge transfer within a cycle).
XBOOTP cinp vdddig vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=0.42 nf=1
XBOOTN cinn vdddig vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=20 w=0.42 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network (referenced to the 50 uA injected at ib)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS mirror reference diode.
XREF ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.5 nf=2
* vbp: PMOS load gate bias.  The diode runs at the same current density
* as the loads, so the loads mirror its current 100/11.1 times.
XPDIODE vbp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.1 nf=2
XPNMIR vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=23 nf=4
* vbp2: gate bias for the cascode-branch PMOS source (low voltage drop
* so the vcasn stack can sit high).
XPDIODE2 vbp2 vbp2 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.8 nf=2
XPNMIR2 vbp2 ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=23 nf=4
* vcasn: cascode gate bias stack.  XNDIODE matches the cascode current
* density; XNDIODE2 (low-Vt) sets the low leg around 0.6 V.
XPCASC vddana vbp2 vcasn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.8 nf=2
XNDIODE vcasn vcasn ncas2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.7 nf=2
XNDIODE2 ncas2 ncas2 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=10

.ends test_fct

XPLT_A  casp_a pbias  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=8   nf=2 as=0.56 ad=0.56 ps=8   pd=8

XPLT_B  casp_b pbias  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=8   nf=2 as=0.56 ad=0.56 ps=8   pd=8

XCASP_A coutn  pcpb   casp_a casp_a sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=44  nf=8 as=3.08 ad=3.08 ps=44  pd=44

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue
* amplifier for a sampled-data pipeline stage.
*
* MOS terminal order throughout is D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body).
*
* Each signal half is a telescopic cascode: an NMOS input device with its source
* at analog ground drives an NMOS cascode into the output node, and a PMOS
* current-source load drives a PMOS cascode into the same output node.  cinp and
* cinn are the summing nodes presented by the fixture's flying capacitors; the
* feedback capacitors CFBP/CFBN close the charge-transfer loop so the stage gain
* is C_fly/C_fb.  During 'sam' the summing nodes are pulled back to vcm through
* transmission gates so each cycle starts from a defined charge state.
*
* The output common mode is set by replication rather than by a feedback loop.
* A third branch carries one quarter of the signal-path current: same device
* types, same vcasn/vcasp cascode biases, input gate tied to vcm (the reset
* level of the summing nodes) and every device scaled to W/4.  Because current
* and width scale together, its cascode overdrives match the signal halves.
* Its internal node vcmfb sits between its PMOS and NMOS cascode drains and is
* therefore self-regulating: KCL there forces the replica load current to equal
* the replica input current, i.e. vcmfb settles at the gate voltage at which
* the scaled load passes I_in/4.  vcmfb drives the gates of the four-times
* larger signal-path loads, which then each pass I_in.  Since the loads neither
* source nor sink net charge the output common mode stays where the fixture
* precharges it, and because the reference current is derived from the same
* input device type and bias the tracking holds across process corners.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ================= BIAS NETWORK =================
* 50uA entering ib is sunk by a diode-connected NMOS and mirrored to generate
* the NMOS cascode gate bias and the PMOS cascode gate bias.
XBREF   ib     ib     vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.3  nf=1
XBMIR   n1     ib     vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.3  nf=1
XBPDI   n1     n1     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.3  nf=1
XBCSN   vcasn  n1     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.3  nf=1
XBCDN   vcasn  vcasn  vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.52 w=0.42 nf=1
XBCSP   vcasp  vcasp  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XBCSN2  vcasp  ib     vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.5  nf=1

* ================= P SIGNAL HALF =================
* input W=16 -> cascode W=40/L=0.5 (low Vov, long L for high output resistance)
XMINP   xp     cinp   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16  nf=1
XMCNP   coutp  vcasn  xp     vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=40  nf=1
XMCPP   coutp  vcasp  yp     yp     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=88  nf=1
XMLPP   yp     vcmfb  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=90  nf=1

* ================= N SIGNAL HALF =================
XMINN   xn     cinn   vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16  nf=1
XMCNN   coutn  vcasn  xn     vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=40  nf=1
XMCPN   coutn  vcasp  yn     yn     sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=88  nf=1
XMLPN   yn     vcmfb  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=90  nf=1

* ================ REPLICA BRANCH (load gate bias generator) ================
* Same device types and cascode biases as a signal half, every width scaled to
* W/4, input gate tied to vcm.  Single series path VDD -> yrep -> vcmfb ->
* xrep -> VSS, so KCL at vcmfb sets the load gate voltage for I_in/4.
XRINP   xrep   vcm    vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4   nf=1
XRCNP   vcmfb  vcasn  xrep   vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=10  nf=1
XRCPP   vcmfb  vcasp  yrep   yrep  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=22  nf=1
XRLPP   yrep   vcmfb  vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=22  nf=1

* ================= FEEDBACK CAPACITORS =================
CFBP cinp coutp 58f
CFBN cinn coutn 58f

* ================= SUMMING-NODE RESET =================
* sam_b is the local complement of sam; bulks tied to vcm remove the body effect.
XINVN   sam_b  sam    vdddig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8    nf=1
XINVP   sam_b  sam    vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12   nf=1

XRSNP_N cinp   sam    vcm    vcm    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5    nf=1
XRSPP_P cinp   sam_b  vcm    vcm    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6    nf=1
XRSNN_N cinn   sam    vcm    vcm    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5    nf=1
XRSPP_N cinn   sam_b  vcm    vcm    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6    nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
*
* Architecture: switched-capacitor inverting charge-transfer gain stage.  The
* bench-owned 400 fF flying capacitors sample vinp/vinn against vcm during sam
* and dump their charge into the DUT summing nodes cinp/cinn during transfer.
* A fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA holds the summing nodes at their
* self-biased common mode, so the dumped charge transfers into the feedback
* capacitors CF and the sampled differential gain is the ratio Cfly/CF.
*
* The outputs are reset once per cycle by NMOS clamps to vcm driven from the
* sam port: with cout clamped to vcm the loop pulls the summing nodes back to
* the same potential, discharging CF so every cycle starts from a clean state.
* The sam edge also releases before transfer rises, so the clamp is safely off
* while charge transfers.  No internal clock buffering is needed.
*
* Sizing note: in the SKY130 wrappers w is the total device width in um and nf
* only sets the finger granularity.  MOS terminal order is D G S B.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ bias
* 50 uA reference diode at the ib pin (NMOS mirror reference).
XMIB ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1
+ ad=1.8 as=1.8 pd=6.6 ps=6.6
* PMOS load mirror diode (pbias) fed by a 1:1 NMOS mirror of the ib diode.
XPDIO pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=18.8 nf=1
+ ad=2.82 as=2.82 pd=10.3 ps=10.3

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s fully-differential floating charge-transfer residue amplifier.
* Transistor-level TEST_FCT core only: the public fixture owns the flying
* capacitors, the input sampler, the output precharge and the output T/H.
*
* Architecture: pseudo-differential.  Two identical cascoded five-transistor
* OTAs, one per half-circuit.  The reference input of each pair is tied to the
* vcm pin, so the reset loop (closed by the pmos reset device while `transfer`
* is low) parks both outputs at vcm and the differential charge transfer sets
* the gain.  An NMOS cascode lifts the signal-side output impedance.
*
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias core --
* Diode-connected NMOS on ib absorbs the external 50 uA reference and fixes
* V(ib); every tail and mirror below is a current mirror of that node.
xbd_ib  ib     ib      vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8 nf=1

* cascode gate bias: an ib-mirrored branch feeds a pmos mirror and a
* diode-connected NMOS, so vcas = V(ib) + Vgs(xmn_dc) and the cascode sits one
* overdrive above its source.
xmn_pd  pb     ib      vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8 nf=1
xmp_pd  pb     pb      vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=3.2 nf=1
xmp_cb  vcas   pb      vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=3.2 nf=1
xmn_cm  ncasc  ib      vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8 nf=1
xmn_dc  vcas   vcas    ncasc  vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------- N half-circuit cinn->coutn
xin_n    c1n    cinn    tln    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1
xref_n   d1n    vcm     tln    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1
xcas_n   coutn  vcas    c1n    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=39 nf=1
xmpd_n   d1n    d1n     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=1
xmpo_n   coutn  d1n     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=1
xtail_n  tln    ib      vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------- P half-circuit cinp->coutp
xin_p    c1p    cinp    tlp    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1
xref_p   d1p    vcm     tlp    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1
xcas_p   coutp  vcas    c1p    vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=39 nf=1
xmpd_p   d1p    d1p     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=1
xmpo_p   coutp  d1p     vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=32 nf=1
xtail_p  tlp    ib      vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=1

* --------------------------------------------- feedback capacitors (ideal) ---
cfb_n    cinn   coutn   60f
cfb_p    cinp   coutp   60f

* ---------------------------------------- reset devices: on while transfer low
xrsw_n   coutn  transfer cinn  vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
xrsw_p   coutp  transfer cinp  vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1

.ends test_fct

circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier core.
* Fully differential switched-capacitor charge-transfer amplifier:
*   - NMOS cascoded input pair on the floating charge-transfer nodes cinn/cinp
*   - PMOS cascoded current-source loads
*   - Ideal feedback caps set the charge gain Cfly/Cfb ~ 6
*   - sam-phase transmission-gate reset switches establish input/output CM
*   - switched-cap CMFB steers the PMOS load bias node pbm
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network (50 uA reference on ib) ----------------
* reference diode NMOS: vgs_n @ 50 uA
XBN_D0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* 50 uA pull-down for the PMOS diode branch
XBN_M1 pbias_d ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* diode PMOS: pbias_d = vdd - vgs_p @ 50 uA
XBP_D0 pbias_d pbias_d vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* 25 uA pull-down for the PMOS cascode-bias stack
XBN_M2 pbias2 ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* stacked PMOS diodes: pbias2 = vdd - vgs_p - vgs_p(wide)
XBP_B1 na na vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XBP_B2 pbias2 pbias2 na vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
* NMOS cascode bias: nbias2n ~ 1.15 V (single diode at 50 uA)
XBP_F2 nbias2n pbias_d vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XBN_B1 nbias2n nbias2n vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
* weak keeper so pbm has a defined operating point before the first sam
XBN_WK pbm pbm vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.5 nf=1

* ---------------- tail and cascoded input pair ----------------
XMP_T tailn ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=8
XMN_1 sp cinp tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=10
XMN_2 sn cinn tailn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=10
XMN_K1 coutp nbias2n sp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=100 nf=8
XMN_K2 coutn nbias2n sn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=100 nf=8

* ---------------- PMOS cascode loads ----------------
XBP_C1 ntop1 pbm vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=102 nf=4
XBP_C2 ntop2 pbm vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=102 nf=4
XBP_K1 coutp pbias2 ntop1 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=8
XBP_K2 coutn pbias2 ntop2 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=80 nf=8

* ---------------- switched-cap CMFB ----------------
CCM1 coutp pbm 60f
CCM2 coutn pbm 60f
XMN_SW pbm sam pbias_d vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1

* ---------------- reset switches: NMOS gated by sam, PMOS by transfer ----------------
* (transfer is low during the whole reset window, so no inverter is needed)
XMN_R1 cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=4
XMN_R2 cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=4
XMN_R3 coutp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=4
XMN_R4 coutn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=4

* ---------------- feedback caps (gain = Cfly/Cfb) ----------------
CFB1 cinp coutp 62f
CFB2 cinn coutn 62f

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s FCT residue-amplifier core.
* Fully differential cascoded transconductor with capacitive feedback.
* During sam, cinp/cinn are reset to vcm through transmission gates and the
* fixture precharges the outputs. During transfer, the fixture flying caps
* (400 fF) inject their sampled charge into cinp/cinn; the virtual ground of
* the high-gain core pushes that charge into the internal feedback caps, so
* the sampled differential gain is set by Cfly/Cfb.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk)

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------- bias network (from 50 uA ib reference) ----------------
* NB0: diode-connected reference; vnb0 biases the tail current source.
XNB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* Tail current source for the differential pair (~28x mirror).
XNT ntail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=64
* PMOS load bias: diode PMOS XP0 with mirrored 50 uA.
XNB3 vpp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XP0 vpp vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=8.4 nf=2
* NMOS cascode bias vbn: wide diode stack, current from PMOS mirror XPB1.
XPB1 vbn vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=16.8 nf=4
XNB2 vbn vbn nb1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=4
XNB1 nb1 nb1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18 nf=4
* PMOS cascode bias vpc: scaled replica branch (load + diode-connected
* cascode) carrying a mirrored 50 uA, so vpc tracks the main stack.
XNB4 vpc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XPR1 b1r vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=8.4 nf=2
XPCR vpc vpc b1r vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=1.2 nf=1

* ---------------- differential pair with cascodes ----------------
XN1 a1 cinp ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=64 nf=8
XN2 a2 cinn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=64 nf=8
XNC1 coutn vbn a1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=12
XNC2 coutp vbn a2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=12
XP1 b1 vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=210 nf=30
XP2 b2 vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=210 nf=30
XPC1 coutn vpc b1 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=60 nf=12
XPC2 coutp vpc b2 vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=60 nf=12

* ---------------- feedback capacitors (gain = Cfly/Cfb) ----------------
CFB1 cinp coutn 58.5f
CFB2 cinn coutp 58.5f

* ---------------- sam-phase reset switches (LVT for 1 V nodes) ----------
* Local inverter for sam_b, powered from the digital supply.
XNINV sam_b sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPINV sam_b sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
* Input reset: transmission gates tie cinp/cinn to vcm during sam.
XNS1 cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XPS1 cinp sam_b vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XNS2 cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XPS2 cinn sam_b vcm vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
* sam-phase output reset/equalization: pulls both outputs to the internal
* vocmi replica of the fixture precharge level so the sample_out
* reconnection is symmetric and no signal residue survives.
XNSHORT coutn sam coutp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
* Internal ~0.9 V replica of the fixture vocm precharge level.
XNVC vocmi vocmi vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XPB2 vocmi vpp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=8.4 nf=2
XNRST1 coutn sam vocmi vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XNRST2 coutp sam vocmi vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
* Weak keepers so the floating input nodes have a defined DC operating point.
XNL1 cinp vcm vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42 nf=1
XNL2 cinn vcm vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Fully differential FCT residue amplifier - simple diff pair + current source loads.
* Charge-transfer gain = C_fly/Cf ≈ 6. OTA needs A_OL*β >> 1 for accuracy.
* No cascode: avoids headroom conflicts at Icm=1.0V.
* Tail 200uA, input 100uA/side, PMOS loads 100uA/side.
* Tail at edge of saturation (Vds_tail=0.5V ≈ Vov_tail), input pair sized for Vgs=0.5V.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* === Bias from 50uA reference ===
XM_NREF ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* Tail: ~4x mirror of 50uA = 200uA. W/L=28 gives Vgs≈0.89V, Vov≈0.49V
* Vds_tail = 0.5V (source of input pair) ≈ Vov → edge of saturation, acceptable.
XM_TAIL tail_n ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2

* PMOS bias: self-biased NFET(2/1)+PFET(4/0.5) → pb_int ≈ 0.9V
XM_PB_N pb_int ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XM_PB_P pb_int pb_int vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* === Differential pair ===
* NMOS input pair: W/L=80, Vgs=0.5V at 100uA each. Source at 0.5V.
* Drain at 0.9V → Vds=0.4V > Vov=0.1V → saturation ✓
XM_N1 coutn cinp tail_n vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=8
XM_N2 coutp cinn tail_n vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=8

* PMOS current source loads: W/L=16, Vsg=0.9V at 100uA each.
* Vout≈0.9V → Vsd=0.9V > Vov=0.5V → saturation ✓
XM_PL1 coutn pb_int vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4
XM_PL2 coutp pb_int vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=4

* === Feedback caps ===
Cf_P coutn cinp 66.7f
Cf_N coutp cinn 66.7f

* === Reset feedback caps during sam ===
XM_RST_P coutn sam cinp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM_RST_N coutp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s fully differential FCT residue-amplifier core.
* Charge-transfer amplifier: the fixture flying capacitors dump the sampled
* differential charge onto cinn/cinp during `transfer`; an NMOS input pair
* with capacitive feedback (Cf = Cfly/6.3) sets the sampled gain by ratio.
* Bias currents are transfer-gated (head/foot switches) so the loop is only
* active during the transfer window; a switched-capacitor CMFB loop refreshed
* during `sam` pins the output common mode across corners, and sam-phase
* reset switches anchor the input nodes to vcm.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* --- bias reference: diode-connected NMOS sinks the 50 uA ib reference ---
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* --- transconductance core: NMOS pair + NMOS cascode, PMOS load + cascode ---
XMNP d1p cinp tpair vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=20
XMNN d1n cinn tpair vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=20
XMCASP coutp vbnc d1p vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=40 nf=8
XMCASN coutn vbnc d1n vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=40 nf=8
* --- tail current source and transfer-gated foot switch ---
XMTAIL tpair ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=320 nf=54
* --- PMOS current loads, load cascodes, transfer-gated head switch ---
XMPLP d3p vbp0 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=20
XMPLN d3n vbp0 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=120 nf=20
XMPCLP coutp vbpc d3p vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=120 nf=18
XMPCLN coutn vbpc d3n vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=120 nf=18

* --- feedback capacitors set the charge-transfer gain Cfly/Cf ---
CFBP coutp cinp 62f
CFBN coutn cinn 62f

* --- switched-capacitor CMFB: average of outputs couples onto vbp0 ---
CCMP coutp vbp0 30f
CCMN coutn vbp0 30f
XMSWCM vbp0 sam vb0p vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* --- input reset switches: anchor cinn/cinp to vcm during sam ---
XMRSWP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=10
XMRSWN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=60 nf=10

* --- vbpb: PMOS mirror master bias (self-starting push/pull branch) ---
XMB4 vbpb ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
XMPD0 vbpb vbpb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

* --- vbnc: NMOS cascode bias (~1.4 V), tracks corner ---
XMPB1 vbnc vbpb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMD2 vbnc vbnc nb1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.2 nf=1
XMTR1 nb1 vdddig vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.9 w=0.42 nf=1

* --- vbpc: PMOS load-cascode bias (~0.25 V): pushed current into triode NMOS ---
XMPB2 vbpc vbpb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XMT2 vbpc vdddig vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.7 w=0.42 nf=1

* --- vb0p: replica PMOS-load diode generating the CMFB reset bias ---
XMB3 vb0p ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1
XMPLR vb0p vb0p vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1

* --- bias-node filter caps: keep mirror gates stiff against clock-phase
*     charge kicks (tail Cgs coupling into ib, cascode-gate coupling, ...) ---

circuit:
* Floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Three-phase operation (fixture owns Cfly, output precharge, output T/H):
*   sam=1      : reset internal virtual ground / outputs to vcm
*   transfer=1 : fixture dumps Cfly charge onto the internal Ci; OTA produces residue
*   otherwise  : outputs held on Ci while the fixture tracks/holds cout
*
* Charge-amplifier gain = Cfly/Ci (fixture Cfly = 400 fF).
* The virtual ground is reset to vcm so flying-cap charge is purely
* Cfly*(vin-vcm) with no constant offset. Input CM equals vcm, so the
* transferred charge is purely differential and output CM stays at vcm.
*
* Each half is a single-ended inverting OTA: NMOS common-source + PMOS
* current-source load. Gain = gm*(ro_n||ro_p); Ci provides negative feedback.
* Input TGs stay closed for the whole transfer window so Cfly fully dumps.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local leaf subcircuits (MOS wrappers + ideal C only)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fct_inv_std a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fct_inv_std

.subckt fct_nand2 a b y vdd vss
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNA y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNB mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fct_nand2

.subckt fct_tgate a b en en_b vdd vss
XN a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XP a en_b b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
.ends fct_tgate

* Narrow reset switch: less charge injection when sam releases.
.subckt fct_tgate_s a b en en_b vdd vss
XN a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP a en_b b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
.ends fct_tgate_s

.subckt fct_weak_r a b vdd vss
XR a vdd b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=12 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends fct_weak_r

* Single-ended inverting OTA: NMOS CS + PMOS current-source load.
* Long L for high ro (A0 = gm*(ro_n||ro_p)); W/L kept so I_n = I_p at
* vgnd = vout = vcm.
.subckt fct_ota vgnd vout pbias vdd vss
XN vout vgnd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XP vout pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=192 nf=8
.ends fct_ota

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock generation on the digital supplies
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINV_SAM_B sam sam_b vdddig vssdig fct_inv_std
XINV_XFER_B transfer transfer_b vdddig vssdig fct_inv_std

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: sink the 50 uA reference; generate pbias for PMOS current sources
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNBIAS ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XNPMIR pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XPDIODE pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Charge amplifier: inverting OTA with Ci feedback around each side
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XOTA_P vgndp coutp pbias vddana vssana fct_ota
XOTA_N vgndn coutn pbias vddana vssana fct_ota

* Feedback / integrate capacitors: gain = Cfly/Ci = 400f/62f ~= 6.45
CIFB_P coutp vgndp 62f
CIFB_N coutn vgndn 62f

* DC paths so virtual ground is defined outside reset.
XWK_P vgndp vcm vddana vssana fct_weak_r
XWK_N vgndn vcm vddana vssana fct_weak_r

* Input TGs: closed for the whole transfer window so Cfly fully dumps
* onto Ci before the fixture disconnects at the end of transfer.
* Input path always on: cinp/cinn track vgnd so Cfly dumps onto Ci
* without a floating-node glitch when the fixture connects.
XTG_IN_P cinp vgndp vddana vssana vddana vssana fct_tgate
XTG_IN_N cinn vgndn vddana vssana vddana vssana fct_tgate

* Reset TGs during sam: force virtual ground and outputs to vcm.
XTG_RV_P vgndp vcm sam sam_b vddana vssana fct_tgate_s
XTG_RV_N vgndn vcm sam sam_b vddana vssana fct_tgate_s
XTG_RC_P coutp vcm sam sam_b vddana vssana fct_tgate_s
XTG_RC_N coutn vcm sam sam_b vddana vssana fct_tgate_s

.ends test_fct

circuit:
* 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge-Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
* TEST_FCT transistor-level core.
*
* Architecture: continuous-time fully-differential OTA with sampled feedback
* capacitor Cf. During `sam` the input switches hold cinp/cinn at vcm so each
* cycle starts from an identical DC state. During `transfer` the fixture dumps
* the flying-capacitor charge onto the summing nodes; the OTA holds the summing
* nodes at virtual ground and integrates the charge onto Cf, producing
* coutp/coutn = balance + (Cfly/Cf)*(vinp - vinn).
*
* Bias: all currents derived from the 50 uA reference on `ib`.
* Only SKY130 MOS devices and ideal capacitors are used.
* MOS terminal order: drain gate source bulk/body
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network
* XIB : diode-connected NMOS on the ib pin -> VBN (=v(ib))
XIB ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* Reference branch: vdd -> diode PMOS -> VBP (50 uA reference)
XPVDD vbp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* Sink branch: sets VBP by sinking the 50 uA reference (gate = VBN)
XNVDD vbp ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* Tail current source: 40x mirror of ib -> 2 mA (1 mA per side)
XM9 tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=40
* PMOS current-source loads: 20x mirror of ib -> 1 mA each (matches tail/2)
XM3 coutp vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=20
XM4 coutn vbp vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=20

* Fully differential OTA (short channel for high ft / slew rate):
*   NMOS input pair M1/M2, gates = summing nodes cinp/cinn, bulk = tail.
*   PMOS current-source loads M3/M4 from VBP.
*   Outputs coutp/coutn at the drains.

XM2 coutn cinn tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4

XSI2 cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1

circuit:
* ============================================================================
* TEST_FCT: 900 MS/s fully-differential floating charge-transfer residue amp.
* SKY130 transistor-level core.  v5
*
* Architecture: two-stage fully-differential OTA in a capacitive-feedback
* charge amplifier.  Sampled gain = C_MSB / C_f = 400f / 63f = 6.35.
*
*   stage 1: LVT NMOS input pair (M1/M2, high overdrive for linearity and
*            headroom at vcm=1.0V), NMOS cascodes (M3/M4), long-channel
*            PMOS loads (M5/M6) -> high-impedance nodes xp / xn.
*   stage 2: cross-coupled common-source gain: M9p (gate xn) + cascode M11p
*            deliver coutp; M9n (gate xp) + cascode M11n deliver coutn.
*            PMOS current-source loads M10p/M10n share pbias1.
*   Miller compensation caps Cc (coutp<->xn, coutn<->xp) set the loop
*   bandwidth with beta = Cf/(Cf + C_MSB + Cin).
*
* The fixture's sam window never overlaps transfer, so the reset switches are
* driven directly from the sam pin (ideal bench source): during sam they
* clamp cinp/cinn to vcm and short coutp<->cinp / coutn<->cinn, discharging
* C_f and re-defining the output common mode every cycle (no CMFB needed).
*
* All bias currents mirror the 50 uA entering the ib pin (master diode XMB0,
* sized for ~1.0 V gate drive so the tail cascode keeps overdrive).
* ============================================================================
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- gain capacitors: gain = C_MSB / Cf = 400f / 63f = 6.35 ----
CFP cinp coutp 63f
CFN cinn coutn 63f
* ---- Miller compensation (around the inverting second stage) ----
CCP coutp xn 24f
CCN coutn xp 24f

* ---- stage 1: LVT NMOS input pair + NMOS cascodes + PMOS loads ----
XM1 d1 cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=15 nf=10
XM2 d2 cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=15 nf=10
XM3 xp nbias1 d1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM4 xn nbias1 d2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM5 xp pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=208 nf=30
XM6 xn pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=208 nf=30
* tail current source: ~0.8 mA (2x the 400 uA load currents, with margin)
XMTAIL tail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=125 nf=18

* ---- stage 2: cross-coupled CS gain stage, cascoded NMOS pull-down ----
XM9P yp xn vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM11P coutp nbias2 yp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM9N yn xp vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM11N coutn nbias2 yn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XM10P coutp pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=208 nf=30
XM10N coutn pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=208 nf=30

* ---- bias network (all currents mirrored from ib) ----
* master diode at the ib pin: 50 uA, sized for ~1.0 V
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.02 nf=1
* pbias1: PMOS diode (l=0.35) carrying 50 uA; 8x copies source 400 uA in
* M5/M6 (stage 1 loads) and M10P/M10N (stage 2 loads)
XMNB_A pbias1 ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=1.02 nf=1
XMPB_A pbias1 pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=26 nf=4
* nbias1: gate for the stage-1 NMOS cascodes (~1.2 V): two stacked diodes
XMPB_S nbias1 pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=26 nf=4
XMNB_S1 ncas1 ncas1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=15
XMNB_S2 nbias1 nbias1 ncas1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=15
* nbias2: gate for the stage-2 NMOS cascodes (~1.2 V)
XMPB_C nbias2 pbias1 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=26 nf=4
XMNB_T1 tcas1 tcas1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=15
XMNB_T2 nbias2 nbias2 tcas1 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=15

* ---- reset switches: on while sam is high (sam never overlaps transfer) ----
* summing nodes to vcm
XRS_P vcm sam cinp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XRS_N vcm sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* feedback-cap discharge: coutp<->cinp, coutn<->cinn
XRF_P coutp sam cinp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XRF_N coutn sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge-transfer (FCT) residue amplifier core.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* Single-stage fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA used as a switched
* charge amplifier:
*   - Cross-coupled feedback caps CFB (66f) set the charge gain C_MSB/CFB.
*   - During 'sam' the DUT resets: transmission gates short coutn<->cinp and
*     coutp<->cinn, putting the OTA in unity gain.  The CMFB forces the output
*     common mode to ~0.9 V, so the input nodes are simultaneously reset to
*     the OTA input common-mode operating point (~0.9 V).  That makes the
*     reset state exactly equal to the virtual-ground state of the transfer
*     phase, so input parasitics do not modulate the gain.
*   - During 'transfer' the fixture dumps C_MSB*(vin-vcm) into cinp/cinn and
*     the loop settles coutp/coutn = G * differential input around the 0.9 V
*     output common mode.
* Biasing is derived from the 50 uA forced into 'ib'.  A continuous CMFB
* senses the output common mode with source followers, compares it against an
* on-chip ~0.9 V stacked-diode reference, and trims extra PMOS load devices.

.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Feedback capacitors: coutn feeds back to cinp, coutp feeds back to cinn
* (negative feedback through the inverting OTA path).  Gain ~ 400f/66f = 6.06.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CFBA cinp coutn 66f
CFBB cinn coutp 66f

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* OTA core, telescopic cascode.  cinp drives the branch whose output is coutn
* and cinn drives the branch whose output is coutp.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS input pair (Vov ~ 0.2 V, gm ~ 10 mS each at 1 mA).
XM1P ndp cinp ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=80 nf=16
XM1N ndn cinn ntail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=80 nf=16
* NMOS cascodes.
XM2P coutn nb_casc ndp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=76.8 nf=16
XM2N coutp nb_casc ndn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=76.8 nf=16
* PMOS cascodes.
XM3P coutn pb_casc psp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=212.8 nf=32
XM3N coutp pb_casc psn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=212.8 nf=32
* PMOS main current-source loads, fixed gate bias.
XM4P psp pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=212.8 nf=32
XM4N psn pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=212.8 nf=32
* PMOS trim loads driven by the CMFB output.
XM4CP psp cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=38.4 nf=8
XM4CN psn cmfb vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=38.4 nf=8
* Tail current source (mirror of the ib diode, ~2 mA).
XMTAIL ntail ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=200 nf=40

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reset switches (sam): unity-gain configuration coutn<->cinp, coutp<->cinn.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XRSTAN coutn sam cinp vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12.6 nf=3
XRSTAP coutn samb cinp vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25.2 nf=6
XRSTBN coutp sam cinn vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=12.6 nf=3
XRSTBP coutp samb cinn vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=25.2 nf=6
* Clock inverter generating samb on the digital supply.
XINVP samb sam vdddig vdddig sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XINVN samb sam vssdig vssdig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=4

* Weak keepers give the floating input nodes a defined DC state at startup.
XKEEPP cinp vcm vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=2
XKEEPN cinn vcm vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=1 nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generator: 50 uA forced into the ib diode, mirrored everywhere.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMB0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS master reference diode (50 uA) defining pbias.
XMRP pbias pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11.2 nf=2
XMBP1 pbias ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
* nb_casc: 50 uA through one large-Vov NMOS diode (~1.15-1.2 V).
XMPS1 nb_casc pbias vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=11.2 nf=2
XMBNC nb_casc nb_casc vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.58 nf=1
* pb_casc: 50 uA through a large-Vov PMOS diode from vdd (~0.65 V).
XMBPC pb_casc ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
XMBPD pb_casc pb_casc vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.78 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output common-mode feedback.
* Sense followers shift coutp/coutn up by |Vgs|; the reference follower
* shifts the ~0.9 V stacked-diode reference up by the same |Vgs|.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* On-chip ~0.9 V reference: PMOS diode stacked on an NMOS diode.
XMRP9 vref09 vref09 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMRN9 vref09 vref09 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.4 nf=2
* Sense and reference followers (25 uA each so the |Vgs| shifts match).
XSENP cm_s coutp vssana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30 nf=6
XSENN cm_s coutn vssana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30 nf=6
XCMSS cm_s nb_casc vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4 nf=1
XREFF vref_s vref09 vssana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=30 nf=6
XREFS vref_s ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
* Error amplifier: NMOS pair, PMOS diode loads, PMOS common-source stage.
XCT2 ct2 ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=8 nf=2
XC1 cm_a cm_s ct2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=11.2 nf=2
XC2 cm_b vref_s ct2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=11.2 nf=2
XCL1 cm_a cm_a vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=4
XCL2 cm_b cm_b vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=4
XC3 cmfb cm_a vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=44.8 nf=8
XC4 cmfb ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
* Miller compensation for the CM loop.
CCMFB cmfb cm_a 30f

.ends test_fct

taskTitle: Design a 900 MS/s Fully Differential Floating Charge Transfer (FCT) Residue Amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 900 MS/s fully differential floating charge-transfer residue amplifier.
* MOS terminal order: D G S B (drain gate source bulk/body)
*
* Architecture:
* - Always-on two-stage fully differential Miller OTA.
*   Stage 1: NMOS input pair, NMOS cascodes, NMOS current-mirror sinks
*            (diode at d1), PMOS current-source loads.
*   Stage 2: NMOS common-source (gates at d2/d1) + NMOS cascodes, PMOS
*            active loads whose gates sit on the pl2 bias rail.  The load
*            current nearly balances the path current, and the sam-phase
*            precharge re-centers the output common mode every cycle.
* - The fixture flying caps dump their charge packet onto cinn/cinp when the
*   transfer clock rises; the packet is captured in the voltage domain on the
*   total capacitance at cinn/cinp (CADD plus parasitics and CFB), then the
*   OTA resettles that charge onto the cross-coupled feedback caps CFB.
* - sam phase precharges coutn/coutp toward vcm, resetting the feedback caps
*   (the fixture clamps cinn/cinp to vcm during sam).
* - All bias currents mirror the 50 uA ib reference:
*   ib diode -> tail gate (via nt rail), CMFB sink, pl diode feed;
*   pl (PMOS diode) -> load gates and current sources for the ncb/nt rails.
.subckt test_fct cinn cinp coutn coutp ib sam transfer vcm
+ vddana vdddig vssana vssdig

* ---- Feedback and input sampling capacitors ----
CFBP cinp coutn 30f
CFBN cinn coutp 30f
CADDP cinp vssana 40f
CADDN cinn vssana 40f

* ---- Miller compensation ----
CCN d2 coutn 25f
CCP d1 coutp 25f

* Reset d2 onto the d1 diode node during sam: the output precharge slew
* kicks d2 through CCN, and d2 has no restoring force once XMC2 pinches
* off, so without this clamp d2 ratchets toward vdd over several cycles.
XSWD d1 sam d2 vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* ---- sam-phase output precharge (reset) ----
XRPC coutp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2
XRNC coutn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2

* ---- sam-phase input-node reset ----
* The fixture leaves cinn/cinp floating during sam (its transfer_b switch
* only closes during transfer), so the precharge kick coupled through CFB
* would be sampled as a cycle-to-cycle input offset (loop gain > 1).  These
* switches re-clamp the input nodes to vcm every sam phase.
XRSWP cinp sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=49 nf=7
XRSWN cinn sam vcm vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=49 nf=7

* ---- Stage 1 ----
* NMOS input pair.
XM1 n1a cinp tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=27.8 nf=8
XM2 n2a cinn tail vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=27.8 nf=8
* Tail current source (gate on the nt ~ 0.78 V rail).
XMTAIL tail nt vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=46 nf=7
* NMOS cascodes (gate on the ncb ~ 1.28 V rail).
XMC1 d1 ncb n1a vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.5 nf=8
XMC2 d2 ncb n2a vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50.5 nf=8
* NMOS current-mirror sinks (diode at d1).
XMM3 d1 d1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=101 nf=15
XMM4 d2 d1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=101 nf=15
* PMOS current-source loads (gate on the pl ~ 0.65 V rail).
XML1 d1 pl vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=236 nf=34
XML2 d2 pl vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=236 nf=34

* ---- Stage 2 ----
* Common-source devices, gates driven by the opposite stage-1 outputs.
XM5N n5a d2 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM5P n6a d1 vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* Output cascodes.
XM5CN coutn ncb n5a vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=22.5 nf=4
XM5CP coutp ncb n6a vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=22.5 nf=4
* PMOS active loads on the pl2 rail.  The pl2 diode (XMP2) is fed by an
* NMOS copy of the ib reference (XMN5), so the load current tracks the
* NMOS path current of M5 across corners.  Sized so the load sources only
* slightly more than the path sinks; the sam-phase precharge re-centers the
* output common mode every cycle, so no active CMFB loop is needed.
XMLN coutn pl2 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=88 nf=14
XMLP coutp pl2 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=88 nf=14

* ---- Bias network from the 50 uA ib reference ----
* Reference diode.
XMN0 ib ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
* pl rail: PMOS diode fed by a 0.35x NMOS mirror copy of ib.
XMN3 pl ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.4 nf=1
XMP0 pl pl vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.8 nf=2
* pl2 rail: stage-2 load gate bias (PMOS diode fed by a 0.25x ib copy).
XMN5 pl2 ib vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMP2 pl2 pl2 vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.8 nf=2
* ncb rail: PMOS current source (17.5 uA) feeding a high-Vgs NMOS diode.
XMBN ncb pl vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.8 nf=2
XND ncb ncb vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.9 nf=1
* nt rail: PMOS current source (17.5 uA) feeding a low-Vgs NMOS diode.
XMBT nt pl vddana vddana sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11.8 nf=2
XNDT nt nt vssana vssana sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7.6 nf=2

.ends test_fct
